# KLK OLEO CMS Content Inventory

> Structured content and supporting media intended for CMS migration in the revamped website.

## Crawl scope and handoff notes

- **Source:** https://www.klkoleo.com/
- **Captured (UTC):** 2026-09-25T02:08:37+00:00
- **Languages:** Default-site URLs are included; explicit `/de/` and `/cn/` mirrors are excluded. Some default-site timeline/archive records retain German or Chinese labels from the source CMS.
- **Sitemap URLs inventoried:** 474
- **Rendered pages attempted with Crawl4AI:** 474
- **Rendered pages captured:** 454
- **Rendered page failures:** 20
- **Main Products-tab families included:** 8
- **CMS careers captured:** 0
- **WordPress media records captured:** 1,725
- **Additional media found in rendered pages:** 851
- **Media treatment:** source URLs, alt text, captions, and metadata are preserved; media binaries are not copied locally.
- **CMS model for the revamp:** Banners, Products, News & Events, and Careers should be migrated as structured collections.
- **Product scope:** only the 8 product families under the main Products navigation are included. Market pages, Life Science/Oleo Basics market landings, the market-catalogue product sitemap, and market SKU CMS records are excluded from both this deck and the raw inventory.
- **Career-source caveat:** the public careers CMS endpoint currently contains no published job records; the active careers landing-page copy is included below as CMS migration seed content.

## Recommended CMS collection fields

### Banners

`title`, `eyebrow`, `headline`, `body`, `cta_label`, `cta_url`, `desktop_media`, `mobile_media`, `alt_text`, `display_order`, `publish_start`, `publish_end`, `status`

### Products

`name`, `slug`, `summary`, `body`, `product_family`, `market`, `brand`, `featured_media`, `gallery`, `technical_documents`, `seo_title`, `seo_description`, `status`, `source_url`

### News & Events

`title`, `slug`, `type`, `event_date`, `publish_date`, `summary`, `body`, `featured_media`, `gallery`, `location`, `cta_label`, `cta_url`, `seo_title`, `seo_description`, `status`, `source_url`

### Careers

`job_title`, `slug`, `country`, `work_location`, `employment_type`, `summary`, `responsibilities`, `requirements`, `application_url`, `publish_date`, `closing_date`, `status`, `source_url`

## Additional CMS candidates

The following materials have repeatable structures, multiple records, or recurring maintenance needs that make them better suited to structured CMS collections than ordinary pages.

| Priority | Candidate | Crawl evidence | Recommendation |
|---|---|---:|---|
| High | Resources & Documents | 80 records | Create a searchable resource library for brochures, policies, technical documents, sustainability materials, and downloadable files. |
| High | History & Milestones | 126 timeline records | Model milestones as ordered, localizable records instead of maintaining timeline slides manually. |
| High | Brands | 32 unique brand pages | Store brand identity, summary, product-family relationships, imagery, and downloads once for reuse throughout the site. |
| High | Global Locations & Facilities | 13 identified location/facility pages | Use structured locations for regional listings, maps, contacts, capabilities, certifications, and enquiry routing. |
| Medium | Reports & Publications | 8 report records | Manage reports by year and type with downloadable files, thumbnails, and archive controls. |
| Medium | Knowledge Hubs / Editorial Series | 13 hub records | Use an article-like collection when these educational pages will continue to grow or require cross-linking. |
| Medium | Accreditations & Certifications | Repeated accreditation material on a dedicated page | Use structured records if certificates, facilities, validity dates, and downloadable evidence require ongoing maintenance. |
| Merge into existing | Exhibition & Conference Pages | 38 event-oriented posts | Import these into the existing News & Events collection with `type = event`; do not create a separate overlapping collection. |

### Suggested fields for additional collections

- **Resources & Documents:** `title`, `slug`, `resource_type`, `category`, `language`, `summary`, `file`, `thumbnail`, `version`, `published_at`, `related_content`, `status`.
- **History & Milestones:** `year`, `date`, `title`, `body`, `image`, `locale`, `display_order`, `status`.
- **Brands:** `name`, `slug`, `summary`, `body`, `logo`, `hero_media`, `product_families`, `downloads`, `external_url`, `status`.
- **Global Locations & Facilities:** `name`, `slug`, `facility_type`, `country`, `region`, `address`, `coordinates`, `phone`, `email`, `capabilities`, `certifications`, `enquiry_route`, `status`.
- **Reports & Publications:** `title`, `year`, `report_type`, `summary`, `file`, `thumbnail`, `published_at`, `status`.
- **Knowledge Hubs:** `title`, `slug`, `summary`, `body`, `featured_media`, `author`, `topics`, `related_products`, `published_at`, `status`.
- **Accreditations & Certifications:** `name`, `issuer`, `certificate_number`, `facility`, `scope`, `valid_from`, `valid_until`, `logo`, `certificate_file`, `status`.

### Materials that should remain pages or system configuration

- Corporate overview, sustainability overview, supply-chain overview, disclaimer, and contact pages are primarily one-off editorial pages.
- Enquiry forms, checkout, cart, account, thank-you, and staging/test pages should remain form, commerce, or system configuration—not editorial CMS collections.
- Category, author, and yearly archive URLs should be generated automatically from collection metadata rather than entered as CMS records.

## Banner copy and homepage messaging (CMS)

# About KLK OLEO
KLK OLEO is a global oleochemical producer, which has integrated complexes located strategically in Malaysia, Indonesia, China, and Europe. KLK OLEO offers an array of high quality, innovative and sustainable products and solutions. We are the manufacturing division of our parent company,[ Kuala Lumpur Kepong Berhad](http://www.klk.com.my), a leading international plantations group listed on Main Market of Bursa Malaysia Securities Berhad with a market capitalisation of approximately RM22.94 (USD5.45) billion at the end of September 2025.
KLK OLEO’s production portfolio ranges from basic oleochemical products, such as Fatty Acids, Glycerine, Fatty Alcohols and Fatty Esters, all the way down the spectrum to specialties, such as Methyl Ester Sulphonates (MES), Surfactants and Phytonutrients. Our products are used in diverse end-use applications, including beauty & personal care, home care, industries & institutional (I&I) cleaning, life science, food & nutrition, lubricants, polymers and more.

##  Efficient
######  ONE IDENTITY, GLOBAL REACH 
KLK OLEO serves our customers from world-class manufacturing facilities strategically located across Malaysia, China, Indonesia, Europe, and our newly established international sales office in the Americas. With a team of techno-commercial professionals, we are committed to delivering the beneﬁts of market knowledge, sales responsiveness and formulation support, intending to maximise efficiency and improve the quality of your products.  
With a presence in every region, we can react swiftly to your demands and deliver products of the highest standard just-in-time for your production. This will reduce carbon footprint while ensuring product integrity and quality during handling and storage.
![Reliable](https://www.klkoleo.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/02/2025-RISE-Thumbnail-01.png)

##  Reliable
######  GOING THE EXTRA MILE 
Enjoy peace of mind by choosing us as your key partner. Backed by over 100 years of experience, KLK OLEO serves a range of industries and have the knowledge and expertise to help you achieve your product development goals while ensuring performance, quality and security of supply.  
Our global presence ensures that we can effectively support all our customers’ formulation objective at a local level. Reach out to us, and we will always go the extra mile to develop a product that enriches all human lives, today and tomorrow.

##  Integrated
######  DISCOVER PRODUCTS THAT TRANSFORM INDUSTRIES AND LIVES 
KLK OLEO offers a comprehensive product portfolio with high synergies from basic oleochemicals to downstream derivatives and speciality chemicals that are easily adaptable to the needs of different industries and markets. Our products have the assurance of supply reliability, traceability, and sustainability throughout the value chain, backed by our operations’ vertically and horizontally integrated nature.

##  Sustainable
######  PRODUCTS THAT MAKE A DIFFERENCE 
Meet your sustainable goals and further improve your sustainability proﬁle with KLK OLEO products. New applications such as bioactives, biofuel, biolubricants, green chemicals, bioplastics, and biopolymers will increase your ethical and environmentally friendly credentials.  
Trusted by top FMCGs worldwide, our commitment to No Deforestation, No Peat, and No Exploitation (NDPE), reducing Greenhouse Gas (GHG) emissions, Roundtable on Sustainable Palm Oil (RSPO) and sustainability policy throughout our supply chain and operations ensure that our products exceed the most stringent environmental standards.

# Celebrating 100 Years of Excellence in Delden
10 Jun 2026
For a full century, the site along the Langestraat has been a familiar landmark for anyone passing through this corner of Twente. The chimney that once bore the name Servo is long gone, but the chemical company behind it, today known as KLK Kolb Specialties B.V., part of KLK OLEO Surfactants, remains deeply woven into the fabric of the region. A centenary worth celebrating.
The seven-hectare site is a world of its own. Laboratories, research facilities and towering reactors holding tens of thousands of litres operate virtually without pause, the only exception being public holidays. Visitors quickly learn the rules: beyond a clearly marked yellow line, only specially approved mobile phones are permitted. Safety is non-negotiable in this industry.
**From Delden into Every Home**  
The plant does not manufacture finished consumer products. Instead, it produces surfactants, which are surface-active agents that allow oil and water to mix, or make substances soluble that would otherwise refuse to dissolve. These chemical building blocks end up in shampoos, laundry detergents, wall paints and textiles. In other words, there is a good chance something made in Delden is sitting in your home right now.
**From a Steam Laundry to a Global Group**  
The story begins in 1926, when two local entrepreneurs, Kuiper and Rozenbroek, set up shop in a disused steam laundry after their original plan to build in Enschede fell through. They served the Twente textile industry, and during the Second World War even pivoted to food production when circumstances demanded it.
Decades of growth, restructuring and ownership changes followed. Locally the site is still affectionately called Servo, even though that name was officially retired in 2000 and the iconic chimney demolished in 2018. Today the company is owned by Swiss-based Kolb Distribution Ltd., itself part of KLK OLEO, the oleochemical arm of Malaysian conglomerate Kuala Lumpur Kepong Berhad.
**More Than Just a Factory**  
The site is unusually well-equipped for an industrial location. It has its own volunteer fire brigade, a dedicated wastewater treatment plant, and most remarkably, a private railway spur that branches off the Zutphen–Oldenzaal line and runs directly onto the premises. Freight trains have used this connection for decades to deliver raw materials straight to the factory floor.
The railway has not always run without incident. In the early 1980s a wrongly set switch accidentally directed a passenger train onto the site. It was stopped in time, nobody was hurt, and the story has since become part of company folklore.
**Three Generations, Fifty-Year Careers**  
Walk through the site with a long-serving colleague and you quickly sense that this is more than just a workplace. Over 200 people are employed here, the vast majority from Delden and the wider Twente area, with many of them cycling in each morning. Staff turnover is remarkably low: three employees recently marked 40 years of service, and last year one colleague reached 50. There are families where three generations have worked on the same site, and farmers’ sons who once looked for a temporary job and never left. That kind of loyalty speaks for itself.
**Centenary Celebrations**  
The anniversary programme ran across several days. A business reception took place on Thursday 30 April, followed on Friday 1 May by a gathering for retirees and former staff, with dignitaries including the mayor, a provincial executive and the Count of Twickel in attendance, and an evening party for current employees.
On Saturday 2 May, the site opened its doors to the general public. As production continues around the clock and safety rules are strict, visitors were guided around the grounds by bus. The programme included live demonstrations by the company fire brigade and a kids’ science lab.
**From a small chemical supplier for the local textile industry to a global player in specialty chemistry; one hundred years of growth, resilience and community. The story of KLK Kolb Specialties is far from over, and the next hundred years have already begun.**
![KLK Kolb 100 Years Anniversary](https://www.klkoleo.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/06/KLK-Kolb-100-Years-Anniversary.png)

# Commander of the Order of Leopold II Award
30 Aug 2021
The King of Belgium has conferred upon the CEO of [Kuala Lumpur Kepong Berhad (“KLK”)](http://www.klk.com.my/) Tan Sri Dato’ Seri Lee Oi Hian the Commander of the Order of Leopold II during a private ceremony on 26 August 2021.
The prestigious National Order was officially presented to Tan Sri Lee on behalf of King Philippe of the Belgians by the Ambassador of Belgium to Malaysia His Excellency Pascal Grégoire. This award is given in honour of [KLK Tensachem’](https://tensachem.com/)s (part of KLK OLEO) transformation and contribution to the Sovereign of Belgium.
![](https://www.klkoleo.com/wp-content/uploads/2021/11/KLKs-CEO-Tan-Sri-Dato-Seri-Lee-Oi-Hian-awarded-the-Commander-of-the-Order-of-Leopold-II.jpg)Tan Sri Lee giving his acceptance speech and looking on is Belgium Ambassador to Malaysia H.E. Pascal Grégoire
This Order, which was established on 24 August 1900, is awarded for meritorious service to the Sovereign of Belgium by Royal Decree, as a token of His personal goodwill. According to Mr Ambassador Grégoire, the Order is roughly equivalent to the British Victorian Order, which is a personal gift as well of the British monarch and has similar cases.
![](https://www.klkoleo.com/wp-content/uploads/2021/11/KLK-Tensachem.jpg)An ariel view of KLK Tensachem S.A. production site in Ougrée, Belgium
It was an honour to have other dignitaries to witness the momentous occasion. Also present at the ceremony was newly appointed Ambassador of Malaysia to Belgium H.E. Dato’ Ahmad Rozian Abd Ghani, Ambassador of the European Union to Malaysia H.E. Mr Michalis Rokas, Berjaya’s Tan Sri Dato’ Seri Vincent Tan and Belgium Embassy’s Deputy Head of Mission Mr Pierrick Massaux. The KLK OLEO team was represented by KLK OLEO CEO Mr Madhev Bala Subramaniam, Managing Director FAL & ME SBU Mr Raghunathan Nair and Managing Director MES Mr Chua Boon Hook.
![](https://www.klkoleo.com/wp-content/uploads/2021/11/Group1.jpg)Above from L-R: Ambassador of Malaysia to Belgium H.E. Dato’ Ahmad Rozian Abd Ghani, Tan Sri Lee Oi Hian, Tan Sri Vincent Tan, Belgium Ambassador H.E. Mr. Pascal Grégoire and Ambassador of the European Union to Malaysia H.E. Mr Michalis Rokas.

# Davos Life Science achieves FSSC 22000 certification, demonstrating unwavering commitment to food safety excellence
23 Jan 2024
![DavosLife E3 full range FSSC 22000 Certification](https://www.klkoleo.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/02/DavosLife-E3-full-range-FSSC-22000-01.png)
Davos Life Science is proud to announce our achievement in the Food Safety System Certification 22000 (FSSC 22000). This achievement signifies our unwavering commitment to delivering the highest standards of food safety to our customers.
FSSC 22000 is an ISO-based food safety management scheme recognised by the Global Food Safety Initiative (GFSI), it meets the highest standards globally, leading to international food industry acceptance.
This certification not only benefits our customers by guaranteeing the safety and quality of Davos Life Science products, but also reinforces the company’s position as a trusted leader in the industry.
Davos Life Science is proud of this accomplishment and remains committed to exceeding industry standards in food safety. We will continue to invest in our food safety management system and strive to deliver the highest quality products to our customers every time.
**About Davos Life Science**  
[Davos Life Science](https://www.klkoleo.com/davoslife/) is one of the leading market players in producing high quality Tocotrienols and Mixed Carotenes from non-GMO palm fruits, sourced directly from RSPO-certified plantations. Tocotrienols have 60x more antioxidative potency compared to α-tocopherol with strong anti-inflammatory properties. DavosLife E3 Tocotrienols are bioactive ingredients for dietary supplements, functional food and beverages, cosmetic and personal care products.
Davos Life Science is part of KLK OLEO, the Oleochemical Division of [Kuala Lumpur-Kepong Berhad (KLK)](https://www.klk.com.my/).

[Home](https://www.klkoleo.com/) » [News & Medias](https://www.klkoleo.com/de/news-media/) » Davos Life Science & ColorNet: Transforming Brazil’s Skincare Future with the Power of Tocotrienols
# Davos Life Science & ColorNet: Transforming Brazil’s Skincare Future with the Power of Tocotrienols
24 Sep 2026
![Davos Life Science & ColorNet Partnership: Transforming Brazil’s Skincare Future with the Power of Tocotrienols](https://www.klkoleo.com/davoslife/wp-content/uploads/2026/09/Davos-ColorNet-Partnership-incosLatam.jpg)
Davos Life Science Sdn. Bhd. as part of KLK OLEO Group, a global leader in natural palm-derived Tocotrienols, and ColorNet, a leading distributor serving Brazil’s beauty and personal care industry, are pleased to announce a strategic partnership to expand the availability of DavosLife E3 Tocotrienols in the Brazilian skincare market.
The partnership marks an important milestone for both organisations as ColorNet becomes Davos Life Science’s authorised distributor for the personal care segment in Brazil. Through this collaboration, both companies aim to introduce scientifically backed Tocotrienols solutions to cosmetic manufacturers and brand owners seeking innovative ingredients for skin health and beauty applications.
**Reveal Natural Radiance. Restore Youthful Luminosity.**
DavosLife E3 Tocotrienols — the “Extraordinary Super Vitamin E” — act on skin through three complementary mechanisms: potent antioxidant activity, powerful anti-inflammatory action, and gene modulation. This triple mode of action is documented across an extensive body of peer-reviewed research covering anti-ageing, skin brightening, blue light and pollution defence, and skin barrier support.
**Clinically demonstrated in human studies**
  * Reduces UV-induced skin redness by up to 26%
  * Reduces UV-induced tanning by up to 32%

**Science Proven Multi-Pathway Benefits from published studies**
  1.     1. _Combats Oxidative stress_ — reduces DNA, lipid and protein oxidation markers: 8-OHdG by up to 66%, malondialdehyde by 44%, and protein carbonyl by 58%.  
Benefits: Helps protect skin from premature ageing, and promotes healthier, more resilient skin.
    2. _Inflammatory response Calms Inflammation & Skin Irritation_ — downregulates key mediators: IL-6 by up to 64%, IL-8 by 72%, and COX-2 by 47%.  
Benefits: Helps soothe redness and sensitivity, supports faster skin recovery, improves overall skin comfort.
    3. _Reduces Hyperpigmentation, Brightens Skin Tone Pigmentation_ — suppresses tyrosinase expression, reducing melanin production by up to 55%.  
Benefits: Helps minimise dark spots and uneven pigmentation, promotes brighter and more radiant skin, and supports a more uniform skin tone.
    4. _Defends Against Pollution-Induced Skin Damage Pollution defence and barrier integrity_ — suppresses PM2.5-induced MAPK signalling, downregulating phosphorylation of p38 by 61%, JNK1/2 by 70% and ERK by 24%. Also protects cells from mitochondria-mediated apoptosis. Under the same conditions, alpha-tocopherol showed no strong inhibitory effect.  
Benefits: Strengthens the skin barrier against urban pollution, helps prevent environmental ageing, enhances skin resilience, reduces visible signs of stress caused by external aggressors, and supports long-term skin vitality.

[Learn more](https://www.klkoleo.com/skin-care/) about the full skincare benefits of DavosLife E3 Tocotrienols.
**Key Consumer Takeaway**
Tocotrienols deliver clinically proven protection against the four major drivers of skin ageing: oxidative stress, inflammation, hyperpigmentation, and environmental pollution, resulting in healthier, brighter, younger-looking, and more resilient skin.
**Sustainably Sourced. Fully Traceable.**
DavosLife E3 Tocotrienols are sourced from sustainably managed palm plantations within the Kuala Lumpur Kepong Berhad (“KLK”) Group, the parent company of Davos Life Science, ensuring full supply chain traceability, consistent batch-to-batch quality, and reliable long-term supply security.
Davos Life Science, a subsidiary of Kuala Lumpur Kepong Berhad (KLK), a leading diversified resource-based manufacturing and international plantation group, is a global producer of high-quality natural phytonutrients. The company specialises in DavosLife E3 Tocotrienols, the extraordinary full-spectrum vitamin E complex comprising of natural Tocotrienols and tocopherol, as well as DavosLife Biocarotene, the Natural Mixed Carotenes. Supported by KLK’s vertically integrated plantation operations and its resource manufacturing division, KLK OLEO, Davos Life Science ensures a sustainable and reliable supply of premium natural phytonutrients to the global market.
As a leader in specialty ingredients and chemicals, ColorNet is uniquely positioned to accelerate the adoption of premium bioactive ingredients in Brazil. By connecting innovative global technologies with local market opportunities, and drawing on its deep expertise in specialty ingredients, chemicals, skincare, and personal care, ColorNet serves as a strategic partner in bringing scientifically validated, high-efficacy bioactive solutions to market. Together, we can shape the future of performance-driven, innovation-led beauty and personal care products.

![](https://www.klkoleo.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/09/KLK-OLEO-e-invite-to-SSW.jpg)
As a global player in oleochemicals and phytonutrients, KLK OLEO/ Davos Life Science offers an array of high quality, natural and sustainable products. We bioactives for nutraceuticals and cosmeceuticals, and functional ingredients for food and nutrition applications. At this year’s SupplySide West we will be showcasing two key products: PALMESTER MCT (Oil and Powder) and DavosLife E3 Tocotrienols.
**PALMESTER MCT (Oil & Powder)** is a versatile single or blend of saturated medium chain length caprylic/capric fatty acids derived from renewable natural raw materials. It functions as an energy booster, helps with weight management, gut health, cognitive health and has a higher absorption rate compared to LCTs. MCTs are used in various applications, like functional food & beverages, flavours, nutrition, pharmaceuticals, and animal feed.
**DavosLife E3 Tocotrienols** is an extraordinary natural Vitamin E comprising the full-spectrum Tocotrienols and α-Tocopherol. It possesses strong anti-inflammatory and up to 60 times more antioxidative properties than α-Tocopherol. DavosLife E3 is a functional ingredient for dietary supplements, foods and beverages, cosmetic and personal care products. Countless research studies have shown that Tocotrienols are beneficial for heart health, liver health, brain health, bone & joint health, radiation protection, skincare, anti-ageing and protection against UV radiation and free radicals.

# First rooftop solar photovoltaics system in KLK OLEO
17 May 2023
Electricity is a key element in KLK OLEO’s manufacturing process and contributes significantly to process costs and greenhouse gas emissions. In 2022, the Group decided to invest in a rooftop solar photovoltaic (PV) system at Palm-Oleo (Klang) Sdn Bhd (POK). The solar PV system produces electricity that is environmentally friendly and sustainable by harnessing the sun’s energy.
A total of 1,576 monocrystalline solar PV modules were installed on available rooftops, including warehouses, loading bays and offices. Through the installation, POK can generate 1 GWh of renewable energy each year, about 5% of its electricity usage.
This system is one of KLK OLEO’s increased efforts to reducing greenhouse gas emissions and achieving Net Zero.
![First rooftop solar PV system in KLK OLEO ](https://www.klkoleo.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/09/MicrosoftTeams-image-42.jpg)The new solar PV system has played a role in reducing greenhouse gas emissions

# Fuel Smarter with Sustainable MCT
20 Aug 2025
# PALMESTER I PLANTERA MCT Oil and Powder  

Sourced from renewable natural ingredients, **PALMESTER I PLANTERA MCT** delivers efficient energy in both oil and powder forms. Its 6–12 carbon chain structure allows for rapid absorption and quick energy release. The oil is neutral in taste, colourless, and odourless—ideal for functional food and beverage formulations. The powder offers versatility for meal replacements, active nutrition, and wellness products. Whether for performance or everyday vitality, **PALMESTER I PLANTERA MCT** drives innovation across today’s nutrition landscape.
## Supporting Health Through Functional Nutrition  

With a metabolic pathway distinct from long-chain fats in the human body, **PALMESTER I PLANTERA MCT** delivers quick energy, supports weight management, and fits well into ketogenic and digestive-friendly diets.
## Versatile Applications Across Food Innovation  

**PALMESTER I PLANTERA MCT** enhances nutritional value and product functionality across diverse applications, from indulgent spreads to next-generation meat alternatives, helping formulators achieve the ideal balance of health, taste, and performance.
In Sauces and Dressings, it enables up to 40% fat substitution without the need for reformulation, delivering ideal texture, sensory appeal, and storage stability.
In Plant-based Meat, it improves chewiness and elasticity, supports oxidative stability, offers potential for full fat replacement, and helps reduce calories by up to 18%.
MCT is a flexible ingredient that fits easily into a wide range of food and beverage formats, supporting both everyday and emerging health-focused innovations.
KLK OLEO offers **PALMESTER I PLANTERA MCT** oil in various grades, while MCT powders are available in different oil loadings to suit specific formulation needs.

# KLK awarded Malaysia’s Best Managed Companies for third consecutive year
20 Sep 2024
![KLK Malaysia’s Best Managed Companies in 2024 Collage](https://www.klkoleo.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/10/Collage.jpg)
KLK has once again been recognised as one of Malaysia’s Best Managed Companies in 2024. This marks the third consecutive year we have received this honour, reflecting our Company’s organisational success and contributions to the industry. The awards ceremony took place on 22 August, at Le Meridien Kuala Lumpur.
This year was particularly special, as KLK’s Executive Chairman, Tan Sri Lee Oi Hian was invited to be a guest speaker to share his insights on “Empowering the Next Generation for Business.”
Tan Sri Lee paid tribute to his father, the late Founder Chairman Tan Sri Lee Loy Seng, during his speech. He shared his experience as a second-generation leader and how he continued to build upon his father’s legacy. Additionally, he highlighted Tan Sri Lee Loy Seng’s subtle yet impactful mentorship and shared three valuable lessons:
  1. **Core** **Values** : “Integrity, humility, loyalty.” Values that Tan Sri Lee Loy Seng lived by, which continue to guide KLK’s dominant culture of **T**.**H**.**R**.**I**.**I**.**L**.
  2. **Purpose** **in** **life** : Finding fulfilment in life goes beyond wealth. It’s about creating a compassionate environment that impacts KLK’s 50,000 employees and their families. Tan Sri Lee Loy Seng reminded us to be good stewards of our stakeholders. Fulfilling this stewardship brings true contentment to life.
  3. **Balancing** **work** **and** **family** : His ability to manage the demands of running a business while fostering family unity and solidarity.

KLK’s COO, Mr. Lee Jia Zhang, accepted the award on behalf of KLK. Ms. Lee Wen Ling, Managing Director of KLK Land, was also invited onstage to answer a few questions about the win.
When asked about the perception of the plantation industry as being part of the “old economy,” Ms. Lee responded: “I believe this view is inaccurate. As consumers become more conscious, there is a growing demand for sustainably produced products. To stay ahead, we must continue exploring and adapting, going beyond sustainability certifications to focus on areas like decarbonisation and traceability, among others.”
Also present at the award gala dinner were KLK Head of Corporate Mr. Teh Kwan Wey and Sustainability & Special Projects AGM Mr. Adrian Tan.

KLK OLEO is the manufacturing division of [KUALA LUMPUR KEPONG BERHAD (KLK)](https://www.klk.com.my/). A leading international Plantations group listed on the Main Board of Bursa Malaysia Securities Berhad.

# KLK OLEO Expands Business Footprint to the Americas
01 Mar 2021
KLK OLEO is a global oleochemical producer with production portfolio ranges from basic oleochemical products, such as[ fatty acids](https://www.klkoleo.com/products/fatty-acids/), [glycerine](https://www.klkoleo.com/?products=gycerine), [fatty alcohols](https://www.klkoleo.com/products/fatty-alcohols/) and [fatty esters](https://www.klkoleo.com/products/esters/), all the way down the spectrum to specialties, such as [methyl ester sulphonate (MES)](https://www.klkoleo.com/our-product/palmfonate-methyl-ester-sulphonate/), [surfactants](https://www.klkoleo.com/products/nonionic-surfactants/) and [phytonutrients](https://www.klkoleo.com/products/phytonutrients/). KLK OLEO products are used in diverse end-use applications, including [home](https://www.klkoleo.com/markets/home-care-industries-institutional-ii-cleaning/) &[ personal care](https://www.klkoleo.com/markets/beauty-personal-care/), pharmaceuticals, [food & nutrition](https://www.klkoleo.com/markets/food-nutrition/), flavours & fragrances, [lubricants](https://www.klkoleo.com/markets/lubricants/), [polymers](https://www.klkoleo.com/markets/polymers/) and industrial chemicals.
KLK OLEO just expanded its business footprint to the Americas with a new sales office at Woodbury, NY, USA. KLK OLEO Americas (KLKOA) will oversee the sales and marketing in the United States, Canada and South America. And continuously maintain and build customer relationships for the KLK OLEO group product portfolio.
KLKOA will create a local distribution network through storage locations across the US for packed and bulk materials to serve the customers in the Americas region with just-in-time deliveries.
As a leader in quality, sustainability, and renewable ingredients worldwide, KLK OLEO is every formulator’s answer to creating sustainable products.

# KLK OLEO invites you to Vitafoods Virtual Expo
18 Aug 2020
VitaFoods Europe is the leading nutraceutical event of the year, connecting health and nutrition business leaders throughout the entire supply chain. At this year’s VitaFoods Virtual Expo,[ **Davos Life Science**](https://www.klkoleo.com/davoslife/) will be highlighting a potential new application of Tocotrienols as a bioactive to protect the body from pollution-induced oxidative stress and low-grade chronic inflammation.
Research studies have shown that prolonged exposure to environmental air pollution can increase morbidity and mortality. Air pollution induces oxidative stress in skin, lung, vascular and heart tissue, triggering redox-sensitive pathways that lead to biological processes like inflammation and cell death.
[**Davos Life Science**](https://www.klkoleo.com/davoslife/) will showcase new research data demonstrating how Tocotrienols can reduce oxidative stress and inflammation markers, alongside practical demonstrations of how Tocotrienols can be incorporated into functional foods and beverages, to emphasise the applicability of Tocotrienols as a bioactive for anti-pollution. This will drive product differentiation for businesses to help them answer a growing consumer need.
Our sales representatives, **Mr. Jimmy Yow** and **Dr. Sharon Ling** will be available for pre-scheduled online meetings (via Vitafoods Virtual Expo platform) throughout **7 to 11 September 2020** , so book a slot to talk to them about how Tocotrienols can be incorporated into anti-pollution formulations.
We look forward to connect with you!
[![](https://www.klkoleo.com/wp-content/uploads/2021/05/KLK-OLEO-e-invite-to-Vitafoods-Virtual-Expo-2020_Final.jpg)](https://registration.gesevent.com/survey/1c4fg0okeua6a)

# KLK OLEO planted 200 Trees at Lower Kinabatangan Wildlife Sanctuary
08 Jul 2023
In line with our sustainability commitment and in conjunction with the Palm & Lauric Price Outlook Conference (POC), KLK OLEO partnered with APE Malaysia (Animal Projects & Environmental Education Sdn. Bhd.) and planted 200 trees in the lower Kinabatangan River Wildlife Sanctuary in Sabah, Malaysia. These trees are to reconnect the forest corridors that serve as habitats for endangered animals.
The following trees were planted on plot 05°27’20.56″ E118°14’24.37″.  
| Tree Species  | Number of Trees  |  
| --- | --- |  
| Bangkal _(Neonauclea subdita)_  | 66  |  
| Talisai Paya _(Terminalia copelandii)_  | 36  |  
| Medang 3 Urat _(Cinamomom sp)_  | 10  |  
| Fig _(Ficus sp)_  | 9  |  
| Lamba _(Colona seratifolia)_  | 6  |  
| Simpoh Laki _(Dillenia excelsa)_  | 30  |  
| Obah Jangkang _(Eugenia cerassiformis)_  | 1  |  
| Tangkol Merah _(Ficus sp)_  | 1  |  
| Pulai _(Alstonia sp)_  | 3  |  
| Medang _(Litsea sp)_  | 2  |  
| Bayor _(Pterospermum elongatum)_  | 36  |  
| **TOTAL**  | **200**  |  
These trees will reach 5m in height in just 5 years and will converge with the rest of the trees to form the forest canopy in less than 10 years. We hope to hear gibbons and birds singing, monkeys swinging from tree to tree, and possibly an orangutan nesting high in the trees!
APE will provide updates on its reforestation site on their social media platforms, including [Facebook](https://www.facebook.com/ApeMalaysia),[ Twitter](https://twitter.com/ApeMalaysia), [Instagram](https://instagram.com/apemalaysia) or [Youtube](https://www.youtube.com/user/ApeMalaysia).
![KLK OLEO for POC 2023 Certificate](https://www.klkoleo.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/07/KLK-Oleo-for-POC-2023-Certificate.png)
**Plant more trees to keep the Earth healthy. Save the environment to save your future.**

# KLK OLEO Received “Thriving in Adversity” Award at Export Excellence Awards (EEA) 2022
10 Dec 2022
KLK OLEO received the “Thriving in Adversity” Award at the Export Excellence Awards (EEA) Gala Night held on 25th November 2022 at M Resort and Hotel in Kuala Lumpur.
Organised by The Star Media Group, EEA celebrates “the best of the best” in the export world. It honours the excellence of homegrown businesses in export and targets to build a community of Malaysian exporters that excels through healthy competition and support of one another.
The award was accepted by Mr. Siew Fook Ming, Deputy CEO, on behalf of KLK OLEO. The award honours KLK OLEO’s efforts and tremendous resilience while navigating global headwinds and demonstrating excellence by thriving in adversity during the Covid-19 crisis.
![KLK OLEO EEA Stage](https://www.klkoleo.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/01/KLK-OLEO-EEA-Stage.png)
During the peak of Covid-19 pandemic, KLK OLEO as an approved essential industry, sustained efforts to maintain operations on units of demand, without compromising the health and wellbeing of the staffs – an invaluable asset. It clustered as a unified team, exercising multiple controls in curbing the spread of Covid-19, while operating on key areas of demand. A Covid-19 task force comprising senior management, working closely with its people, was formed across all its sites.
This award will prove as a catalyst for KLK OLEO to continue excelling in the Malaysian palm oil and oleochemical industry.

# RAM Sustainability Affirms KLK’s Sustainability Rating, Upgrades Environment Rating
10 Apr 2024
RAMC has reaffirmed [Kuala Lumpur Kepong Berhad’s (“KLK”)](http://www.klk.com.my/) Sustainability Rating at Gold (G2). This year, KLK’s environmental performance saw an improvement, with their Environment Rating upgraded from G3 to G2. This upgrade reflects KLK’s strong commitment to mitigating climate change, as evidenced by their target-setting for carbon emissions and their adherence to Greenhouse Gas (GHG) Protocol disclosure standards.
Sustainability has remained a core principle for KLK, fully integrated into their business strategy. This achievement underscores KLK’s ongoing dedication to decarbonisation, supply chain traceability, upholding human rights, ensuring worker safety, protecting biodiversity, and investing in education, environmental initiatives, and their communities and employees.
The RAM Sustainability report highlighted several factors contributing to the reaffirmed G2 rating, including:
  1. **Strong governance practices** , reflected in KLK’s comprehensive Sustainability Policy and the implementation of sustainability programs established under Project SHIFT.
  2. **KLK’s Sustainability Commitments** announced in the previous year.
  3. A commitment to **No Deforestation, No Peat, and No Exploitation (NDPE)** principles, extending to newly acquired operations.
  4. A robust dedication to upholding **Human Rights**.
  5. **Positive impact on the environment, economy and society** through sustainable palm oil production and supply chain.

![KLK recognised as the Most Outstanding Company in the Plantation Sector by AsiaMoney](https://www.klkoleo.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/11/AsiaMoney.jpg)
We are proud to announce that Kuala Lumpur-Kepong Berhad (KLK) was once again recognised as Malaysia’s Most Outstanding Company in the Plantation Sector for Asia’s Outstanding Companies Poll 2022 by AsiaMoney.
The poll, which is based on AsiaMoney’s flagship Brokers Poll, is designed to identify listed companies that have excelled in financial performance, management team excellence, investor relations, and CSR activities.
In total, over 4,620 votes were received from fund managers, buy-side analysts, bankers and research analysts, which concluded on 15 July 2022. The results saw 175 outstanding companies in their respective sectors and market, of which KLK emerged as the winner in the Plantation sector for the second year running.
Check the full list of Asia’s Outstanding Companies Poll 2022 by AsiaMoney [here](https://www.asiamoney.com/article/178jpplzjljf2aywdu3w4ew9mkzazhkigp5cmtfk3ayzxqi9tc/polls/asias-outstanding-companies-poll/asias-outstanding-companies-poll-2022).

# KLKOM is Setting The Milestone in Energy Recycling
30 May 2022
In efforts toward achieving green energy and sustainable manufacturing, [KL-Kepong Oleomas (“KLKOM”)](https://www.klkoleo.com/kl-kepong-oleomas-sdn-bhd/) embarked on a project to utilise vent gas as an additional fuel source.
This initiative has reduced approximately 25% of natural gas consumption by [KLKOM](https://www.klkoleo.com/kl-kepong-oleomas-sdn-bhd/) and is projected to reduce greenhouse gas (GHG) emissions by about 1,900 tons of CO2 equivalent per annum.
This achievement supports KLK Group’s journey in reducing our dependency on fossil fuel combustion to low carbon alternatives, particularly in oleochemicals manufacturing for KLK OLEO.
The world needs you to go green, join us on our journey.

# KLK’s CEO Tan Sri Dato’ Seri Lee Oi Hian named The Edge Billion Ringgit Club 2022’s Outstanding CEO & Value Creator
02 Nov 2022
KLK’s CEO, Tan Sri Dato’ Seri Lee Oi Hian was named The Edge Billion Ringgit Club (BRC) 2022’s Outstanding CEO & Value Creator in an awards ceremony held at Shangri-La Hotel, Kuala Lumpur.
![](https://www.klkoleo.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/11/The-Edge-BRC-Group.png)
The gala dinner and awards ceremony was graced by caretaker Finance Minister Tengku Datuk Seri Zafrul Abdul Aziz.

The awards were given based on genuine merit, with its methodology and evaluation criteria being transparent, verifiable and independently audited. Currently in its 13th year, Tan Sri Tong also hoped that as the BRC awards continue to evolve, business sustainability will also be a factor in the future. This too, was a sentiment that Tengku Zafrul echoed in his keynote address especially in creating a more sustainable and resilient economy by embracing the environmental, social and governance (ESG) principles.
Tan Sri Lee Oi Hian paid tribute to our Founder Chairman to whom he attributed his success and that of KLK’s, as having benefitted from the values laid down by the late Tan Sri Lee Loy Seng.
“I am humbled by this award because this is only possible through the help of many, including the Almighty God. We have to remain consistent, continue our journey based on values,” Tan Sri Lee Oi Hian said after accepting Malaysia’s Outstanding CEO & Value Creator Award.

# New Surfactants from KLKOM’s Sulphation Plants
05 Apr 2021
[KL-Kepong Oleomas Sdn Bhd (“KLKOM”)](https://www.klkoleo.com/kl-kepong-oleomas-sdn-bhd/) has successfully added [Sodium Lauryl Sulphate (“SLS”)](https://www.klkoleo.com/our-product/tensopol-alcohol-sulphates/) and[ Sodium Lauryl Ether Sulphate (“SLES”)](https://www.klkoleo.com/our-product/tensagex-alcohol-ether-sulphates/) into their product portfolio since the first quarter (Q1) of 2021. KLKOM is the second SLS and SLES production site of KLK OLEO group after [KLK Tensachem, Belgium](https://tensachem.com/). The SLS and SLES manufactured by KLKOM are GMP-certified.
The addition of these two products makes the offering from KLK OLEO in Asia more complete, especially in the home and personal care industry.
###### [Sodium Lauryl Sulphate (TENSOPOL SLS)](https://www.klkoleo.com/our-product/tensopol-alcohol-sulphates/)
KLK OLEO produces [TENSOPOL SLS](https://www.klkoleo.com/our-product/tensopol-alcohol-sulphates/) with 100% renewable carbon. It is biodegradable, does not bio-accumulate in water or land, and has a natural origin index of 0.9 in accordance with ISO 16128. KLKOM can produce SLS in the form of needles, powder, as well as liquid.
SLS is one of the primary surfactants widely used in oral care, personal care and home care. SLS is also an effective surfactant used extensively in industrial applications to make floor cleaners, engine degreasers and machine wash detergents. Toothpaste can also use SLS in a lower concentration.
![](https://www.klkoleo.com/wp-content/uploads/2021/09/news-n-events-sls-sles-img01.jpg)
###### [Sodium Lauryl Ether Sulphate (TENSAGEX SLES)](https://www.klkoleo.com/our-product/tensagex-alcohol-ether-sulphates/)
SLES is an anionic surfactant, widely used as a primary surfactant in rinse-off products, such as dishwashing liquid and shampoo.
Produced from natural fatty alcohols, [TENSAGEX SLES](https://www.klkoleo.com/our-product/tensagex-alcohol-ether-sulphates/) features very high purity and low in 1,4-dioxane, salt and colour. It meets the latest regulatory restrictions for household cleaning products and personal care products.
[TENSAGEX SLES](https://www.klkoleo.com/our-product/tensagex-alcohol-ether-sulphates/) is available as a high-active paste and also in the form of low active liquid for easy processing.
![](https://www.klkoleo.com/wp-content/uploads/2021/09/news-n-events-sls-sles-img02.jpg)
With state-of-the-art technology to be completed at the end of 2021, SLES with 1 moles EO produced from KLKOM could achieve 1,4 dioxane specs at 5ppm max, which is one of the most stringent specs in the industry.

# Press Release: KLK OLEO completes acquisition of Temix Oleo
15 Apr 2023
**Acquisition expands KLK OLEO’s product offering for Oleochemicals**
[KLK Emmerich GmbH (“KLKE”)](https://www.klkoleo.com/klkemmerich/en/) a subsidiary of [Kuala Lumpur Kepong Berhad (“KLK”)](https://www.klk.com.my/), under its resource-based manufacturing division known as KLK OLEO, has recently completed its acquisition of a controlling stake in [Temix Oleo SpA (“Temix Oleo”)](https://www.temixoleo.com/) for an undisclosed sum. The transaction was completed after receiving all necessary approvals and fulfilling all customary closing conditions.
“We are thrilled to have completed this acquisition and to welcome the talented team from Temix Oleo to the KLK group. This acquisition is aligned with our long-term strategy and vision for growth by further diversifying our product offering, increasing access to key customers and augmenting our product specialisation strategy across our European operations,” said Uwe Halder, CEO, KLK OLEO Europe.
“We are excited to join forces with KLK OLEO and bring our unique capabilities and expertise to the table. We are confident that this merger will be beneficial for all parties involved and will create new opportunities for growth and innovation,” said Roberto Cella, Managing Director of Temix Oleo.
KLK OLEO is a global integrated oleochemical producer (oleochemical, derivatives and specialty chemicals) with manufacturing sites in Malaysia, Indonesia, China, and Europe. KLK OLEO is the manufacturing division of KLK, a leading international plantations group listed on the Malaysia stock exchange with a market capitalisation of approximately 4.7 Mrd. € as at the end of September 2022.
Temix Oleo is an oleochemical company focused on production of Esters mainly based on renewable feed stocks, and delivering solutions for lubricant, cosmetic, ceramic, coating, rubber and plastics industries. Based in Milan, Italy, Temix Oleo has a production plant in Calderara di Reno, Bologna, with over 100 employees and a turnover of 150 Mio. € in 2022.
KLKE has been assisted by KPMG Italy as financial advisor and for the financial and tax due diligences.
Hogan Lovells, Italian practice, acted as legal advisor for the legal matters.
Temix Oleo has been assisted by LCA Studio Legale for the legal matters.
For more information, please visit [www.klkoleo.com/klkemmerich](https://www.klkoleo.com/klkemmerich/en/) and [www.temixoleo.com](https://www.temixoleo.com/)
![Temix Oleo Acquisition Group Picture](https://www.klkoleo.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/07/Temix-Oleo-Acquisition-Group-Picture.jpg)(From left) Dr. Bors Cajus Abele, Managing Director KLKE, Marco Galateri di Genola, Sagittario S.p.A., Roberto Cella, Managing Director Temix Oleo SpA, Lee Jia Zhang, KLK Group Chief Operating Officer, Piero Rinaldi, S.A.P.I. – Società Azionaria Prodotti Industriali – S.p.A. and Uwe Halder, CEO KLK Oleo Europe, after the signing ceremony on 31 March 2023.

# Press Release: KLK OLEO to acquire Italy-based Temix Oleo
28 Feb 2023
Acquisition will expand KLK OLEOs’ product offering for Oleochemical.
Milan, Italy and Emmerich, Germany – Temix Oleo SpA (“Temix Oleo”) and KLK Emmerich GmbH (“KLKE”), a subsidiary of [Kuala Lumpur Kepong Berhad (“KLK”)](https://www.klk.com.my/), under its resource-based manufacturing division known as KLK OLEO, has entered into a definitive agreement to acquire a controlling stake in Temix Oleo (“the Transaction”).
KLK OLEO is a global integrated oleochemical producer (oleochemical, derivatives and specialty chemicals) with manufacturing sites in Malaysia, Indonesia, China, and Europe. KLK OLEO is the manufacturing division of KLK, a leading international plantations group listed on the Malaysia stock exchange with a market capitalisation of approximately Euro 4.8 billion as at the end of September 2022.
Temix Oleo is an oleochemical company focused on production of Esters mainly based on renewable feed stocks, and delivering solutions for lubricant, cosmetic, ceramic, coating, rubber and plastics industries.
Temix Oleo is located in Milan, Italy with production plant in Calderara di Reno (Bologna) employing around 100 people with a turnover of Euro 150 million in 2022.
The Transaction is expected to be completed by April 2023, subject to regulatory approval and customary closing conditions.
“Temix Oleo outstanding reputation is built on their customer-centric and high-quality service business model. We are excited to welcome the Temix Oleo team and their excellent product portfolio to be part of the group of KLK (“KLK Group”)” said Sriganesh Mathur Subramanian, Managing Director, KLKE.
“This acquisition is an opportunity for Temix Oleo to continue to grow, in product portfolio and geographic areas, with focus on sustainability and innovation. Being part of the KLK Group, employees can look forward to a bright future.“ said Roberto Cella, Managing Director Temix Oleo.
For more information, please visit [www.klkoleo.com/klkemmerich](https://www.klkoleo.com/klkemmerich/en/) and [www.temixoleo.com](https://www.temixoleo.com/)

# Press Release: KLK renews support to Malaysian Mixed Doubles Stars Goh Soon Huat and Shevon Lai
07 Jan 2025
[Kuala Lumpur Kepong Berhad](https://www.klk.com.my/) (“KLK” or the “Group”) is proud to announce the renewal of our sponsorship for Malaysia’s national badminton mixed doubles pair, Goh Soon Huat and Shevon Lai, through 2025. This renewal reflects KLK’s continued commitment to support local sporting talent and fostering national pride.
Since 2023, KLK has been a proud supporter of the pair, who have made remarkable strides on the international stage. In addition to renewing their sponsorship, KLK has extended support to their coach, Teo Kok Siang, ensuring the team has the resources to excel in the coming year.
As part of this partnership, Goh Soon Huat and Shevon Lai will also serve as KLK Brand Ambassadors for DavosLife Science products, including DavosLife E3 Complete Tocotrienols and Revive Skin Care BeauE Collagen.
Commenting on the partnership, KLK Chief Operating Officer, Lee Jia Zhang said, “We are incredibly proud of Goh Soon Huat and Shevon Lai for their dedication and outstanding performance over the past year. Their perseverance and sportsmanship are inspiring and we wish them the very best as they compete in the upcoming PETRONAS Malaysia Open and the 2025 season.”
Goh Soon Huat and Shevon Lai expressed their heartfelt gratitude for KLK’s continued support, saying “Our journey as independent players has been challenging, yet incredibly rewarding. Securing funding and meeting our tournament commitments has been a significant hurdle. KLK’s unwavering trust in our potential, regardless of outcomes, has been empowering. This partnership has not only boosted our confidence but has also provided us the stability to focus on our performance and represent Malaysia with pride.”
Looking ahead, the duo shared their ambitious goals: “Our immediate target for the PETRONAS Malaysia Open is to advance to the quarterfinals. Beyond that, we aim to refine our performance, maintain consistency and break into the world’s top five rankings. In 2024, we came close to securing a Super 1000 championship title in China but narrowly missed it. For 2025 we are motivated to achieve that milestone.”
KLK looks forward to celebrate more milestones with Goh Soon Huat and Shevon Lai as they continue to thrive and make Malaysia proud in the 2025 season.
![Press Release: KLK renews support to Malaysian Mixed Doubles Stars Goh Soon Huat and Shevon Lai](https://www.klkoleo.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/01/DSC_3698.jpg)KLK Chief Operating Officer Mr. Lee Jia Zhang (centre) with Shevon Lai (left) and Goh Soon Huat (right) at the signing ceremony recently
Also featured in [The Star.](https://www.thestar.com.my/metro/metro-news/2025/01/16/corporation-renews-support-for-shuttlers-soon-huat-shevon)

# Press Release: Peng Soon-Liu Ying Receive Support from KLK to Pursue Their Olympic Dream
07 Nov 2020
[Kuala Lumpur Kepong Berhad (“KLK”)](https://www.klk.com.my/), one of the leading plantation companies in Malaysia announces its sponsorship of World rank No 7 Badminton Mixed Doubles, Chan Peng Soon and Goh Liu Ying.  
The sponsorship, in line with its corporate responsibility effort to promote harmonious culture through sports as well as to support our nation’s pursuit for global sports excellence, it is hoped that the Rio silver medallists duo will continue to bring all Malaysians together and make the country proud when chasing their Tokyo Olympics dream.
KLK executive director Lee Jia Zhang said in a statement that, “We understand that the COVID-19 pandemic has changed many of our lives, we are humbled to be able to help ease the financial woes for our Malaysian Mixed Doubles during this difficult period. We hope that with our sponsorship, Peng Soon-Liu Ying can focus and be better prepared for the Games.”
The Tokyo Olympics was deferred for one-year to July 23 – Aug 8 in 2021 due to the pandemic. Although Peng Soon-Liu Ying had forgo the two Denmark Opens in October 2020, they are looking at making a return early next year for the two BWF Opens in Asia. The world No. 7 duo need to stay within the top 16 until next year to qualify for Tokyo Olympics 2021.
Chan Peng Soon has expressed his gratitude to KLK for the support given to Goh Liu Ying and him. “The deferment of this year’s Olympics also meant that we will need to continue to train to maintain our physical form for another 12 months, in which this will require extra financial expenses. Thank you KLK for coming forward to support us during this difficult time as it is not easy to find support and sponsorship during the COVID-19 pandemic”, said Chan.
“The money will help us cover the travel expenses for our future tournaments. We can now focus on qualifying for the Tokyo Olympics and hopefully achieve a better result for Malaysia”, said Liu Ying.
Since turning Pro as independent players, Peng Soon-Liu Ying have done well by winning the 2019 Thailand Masters and New Zealand Open.
The announcement also sees Peng Soon-Liu Ying become the first brand ambassadors for KLK’s [DavosLife E3 Complete](https://www.klkoleo.com/davoslife/estore/), a natural Vitamin E dietary supplement comprising Tocotrienols and alpha tocopherol derived from palm fruits. It is formulated for high bio-absorption and suitable for adults with busy lifestyle and elderly with symptoms of tiredness. Tocotrienols as an antioxidant is beneficial at neutralizing free radicals and may help support overall wellness and vitality and boost healthier body.

Also featured in [The Star](https://www.thestar.com.my/metro/metro-news/2020/11/07/company-backs-doubles-pairs-dream-of-competing-in-olympics) and [Ipoh Echo](https://www.ipohecho.com.my/2020/11/06/peng-soon-liu-ying-receive-support-from-klk-to-pursue-their-olympic-dream/).

# RAM Sustainability upgrades KLK’s overall Sustainability Rating to Gold1 from Gold2
01 Jul 2025
RAM Sustainability upgrades [Kuala Lumpur Kepong Berhad’s (“KLK”)](http://www.klk.com.my/) Sustainability Rating from Gold2 (G2) to Gold1 (G1) for the year 2025. This recognition reflects KLK’s continued progress in Environmental, Social and Governance (ESG) performance.
The upgraded rating highlights KLK’s continuous improvements across the following key areas:
  1. **Environmental:** Progress in climate change reporting and effective implementation of Greenhouse Gas (GHG) emissions reduction initiatives that contributed to absolute GHG reductions in FY2024.
  2. **Social:** Committed to upholding human rights, guided by the Group Sustainability Policy and reinforced through No Recruitment Fee Policy. An independent human rights risk assessment has been completed in our plantation operations in Peninsular Malaysia, with ongoing assessment in Sabah and Indonesia next in line.
  3. **Governance:** The Group’s Sustainability Policy was updated in 2025 to meet the evolving industry expectations. In FY 2024, KLK for the first time obtained limited assurance on selected Global Reporting Initiative (GRI) and the Zoological Society of London’s Sustainable Palm Oil Transparency Toolkit (SPOTT) indicators. 

This upgrade affirms KLK’s ongoing efforts to integrate sustainability into our business operations. This recognition is a testament to the dedication of all colleagues and it serves as a strong foundation for our continued journey towards sustainable growth and responsible stewardship.
Read the report [here](https://www.klk.com.my/wp-content/uploads/2025/06/2025-06-17-KLK-RAM-2025.pdf)  
Find out more about KLK Group and their sustainability efforts at [www.klk.com.my](http://www.klk.com.my/)
**_About KLK OLEO_**
Built on a legacy of integrity, humility, innovation and loyalty, KLK OLEO is committed to providing the best sustainable solutions to address global demands and consumer trends. As a worldwide oleochemical producer with over 100 years of experience, KLK OLEO’s products can be found in most consumer staples, from Beauty & Personal Care, Food & Health Care, Home Care, Industries & Institutional Cleaning, Lubricants to Polymers.
KLK OLEO is the manufacturing division of [KUALA LUMPUR KEPONG BERHAD (KLK)](https://www.klk.com.my/). A leading international Plantations group listed on the Main Board of Bursa Malaysia Securities Berhad.

# TPOZ recognised as amongst Top 10 Model Companies adopting Holistic Safety Culture
24 Dec 2021
As part of the People Republic of China’s government efforts to promote safety culture among enterprises, the Zhangjiagang Emergency Management Bureau recently organised a “Cultivate Safety Culture Demonstration Enterprises Program”. Ten chemical enterprises were selected from around 300 chemical companies within the city as model companies to help publicise and promote safety culture within the Zhangjiagang City and eventually to strengthen the safety culture of the region. The program aims at cultivating and creating a holistic safety culture covering all aspects of safety, particularly in system, environment, and behaviour.
We are pleased to announce that [Taiko Palm-Oleo (Zhangjiagang) Co., Ltd. (TPOZ)](https://www.klkoleo.com/taiko-palm-oleo-zhangjiagang-co-ltd/) is recognised as one of ten chemical enterprises qualified for this program. This recognition will elevate TPOZ’s image in Zhangjiagang Free Trade Zone and Zhangjiagang City. We are indeed proud that our KLK OLEO safety standards and environmental initiatives are being well recognised at our operations in Zhangjiagang, China.

### Discover your potential with KLK OLEO
KLK OLEO’s footprint are in 9 different countries across the world with a workforce surpassing 3,000 employees globally. As we continue to expand our business, we believe that employees are of paramount importance to our long-term business sustainability and growth; thus, we continuously seek talents to join our existing workforce. A career with KLK OLEO means you will be part of something genuinely special. Embracing the Company’s Vision and Values, employees fulfil our Mission to improve more lives and deliver stronger, more effective business results. Through our employee development and competencies framework, we believe in equipping employees with the right tools for their growth and to support the business continuity plan. We are looking for talents with passion, energy, enthusiasm; and more importantly, aligned to our Core Values of _**T** eamwork, **H** umility, **R** esults, **I** ntegrity, **I** nnovation and **L** oyalty._ Join us, be part of our team, and we will unlock your full potential.

| image | KLK OLEO acquired Temix Oleo in April 2023. Together with Temix, we provide biodegradable and sustainable API Group V base oils, surfactants, chemical specialties, raw materials and customer-specific products with high bio-based carbon content for fuel and lubricant applications.  PALMESTER Biolubricant Base Oils and TEMEST Ester Base Oils have good lubricity, viscosity index, solvency & clean burning properties. The esters have excellent oxidative, thermal and hydrolytic stability, hence suitable for various lubricant applications. PALMERE Methyl Esters, PALMEROL Fatty Alcohols, PALMERE Fatty Acids, and ACITEM Tallow-based Fatty Acids are suitable for metalworking fluid applications. PALMERE Methyl Esters are suitable for fuel applications.  Bio-based specialty chemicals, making the match. | /wp-content/uploads/2023/06/China-Inter-Lubric-Thumbnail.png |
| image | One of KLK OLEO’s manufacturing sites – KL-Kepong Oleomas held a ground breaking ceremony on 5th April 2023 for their West Port 2 expansion project, marking an important milestone. This key moment reaffirms KLK OLEO’s as one of the world’s leading oleochemical producers.  Attending the ceremony were several esteemed guests, including KLK Chairman – YM Raja Tun Muhammad Alias, Group CEO – Tan Sri Lee Oi Hian, Group COO – Mr. Lee Jia Zhang, KLK Board of Directors – Dato’ Lee Hau Hian and Ms. Cheryl Khor, BKB Board of Directors – Tan Sri Rastam, Dr. Tunku Alina, Mr. Lee Yuan Zhang and Mr. Lim Ban Aik, Deputy CEOs – Mr. Kow Tiat Yong and Mr. Siew Fook Ming, and Group CFO – Mr. William Ong Eng San alongside members of the MKLK corporate engineering team as well as the West Port 2 site project team. This expansion is focused on increasing capacity for fatty alcohols and fatty acids fractions, increasing KLK OLEO’s capability to better serve our global customers. | image | Davos Life Science & ColorNet Partnership: Transforming Brazil’s Skincare Future with the Power of Tocotrienols / Davos Life Science Sdn. Bhd. as part of KLK OLEO Group, a global leader in natural palm-derived Tocotrienols, and ColorNet, a leading distributor serving Brazil’s beauty and personal care industry, are pleased to announce a strategic partnership to expand the availability of DavosLife E3 Tocotrienols in the Brazilian skincare market. The partnership marks an important milestone for both organisations as ColorNet becomes Davos Life Science’s authorised distributor for the personal care segment in Brazil. Through this collaboration, both companies aim to introduce scientifically backed Tocotrienols solutions to cosmetic manufacturers and brand owners seeking innovative ingredients for skin health and beauty applications.   Reveal Natural Radiance. Restore Youthful Luminosity. DavosLife E3 Tocotrienols — the “Extraordinary Super Vitamin E” — act on skin through three complementary mechanisms: potent antioxidant activity, powerful anti-inflammatory action, and gene modulation. This triple mode of action is documented across an extensive body of peer-reviewed research covering anti-ageing, skin brightening, blue light and pollution defence, and skin barrier support.   Clinically demonstrated in human studies  Reduces UV-induced skin redness by up to 26% Reduces UV-induced tanning by up to 32%    Science Proven Multi-Pathway Benefits from published studies    Combats Oxidative stress — reduces DNA, lipid and protein oxidation markers: 8-OHdG by up to 66%, malondialdehyde by 44%, and protein carbonyl by 58%. Benefits: Helps protect skin from premature ageing, and promotes healthier, more resilient skin. Inflammatory response Calms Inflammation & Skin Irritation — downregulates key mediators: IL-6 by up to 64%, IL-8 by 72%, and COX-2 by 47%. Benefits: Helps soothe redness and sensitivity, supports faster skin recovery, improves overall skin comfort. Reduces Hyperpigmentation, Brightens Skin Tone Pigmentation — suppresses tyrosinase expression, reducing melanin production by up to 55%. Benefits: Helps minimise dark spots and uneven pigmentation, promotes brighter and more radiant skin, and supports a more uniform skin tone. Defends Against Pollution-Induced Skin Damage Pollution defence and barrier integrity — suppresses PM2.5-induced MAPK signalling, downregulating phosphorylation of p38 by 61%, JNK1/2 by 70% and ERK by 24%. Also protects cells from mitochondria-mediated apoptosis. Under the same conditions, alpha-tocopherol showed no strong inhibitory effect. Benefits: Strengthens the skin barrier against urban pollution, helps prevent environmental ageing, enhances skin resilience, reduces visible signs of stress caused by external aggressors, and supports long-term skin vitality.    Learn more about the full skincare benefits of DavosLife E3 Tocotrienols.   Key Consumer Takeaway Tocotrienols deliver clinically proven protection against the four major drivers of skin ageing: oxidative stress, inflammation, hyperpigmentation, and environmental pollution, resulting in healthier, brighter, younger-looking, and more resilient skin.   Sustainably Sourced. Fully Traceable. DavosLife E3 Tocotrienols are sourced from sustainably managed palm plantations within the Kuala Lumpur Kepong Berhad (“KLK”) Group, the parent company of Davos Life Science, ensuring full supply chain traceability, consistent batch-to-batch quality, and reliable long-term supply security. Davos Life Science, a subsidiary of Kuala Lumpur Kepong Berhad (KLK), a leading diversified resource-based manufacturing and international plantation group, is a global producer of high-quality natural phytonutrients. The company specialises in DavosLife E3 Tocotrienols, the extraordinary full-spectrum vitamin E complex comprising of natural Tocotrienols and tocopherol, as well as DavosLife Biocarotene, the Natural Mixed Carotenes. Supported by KLK’s vertically integrated plantation operations and its resource manufacturing division, KLK OLEO, Davos Life Science ensures a sustainable and reliable supply of premium natural phytonutrients to the global market. As a leader in specialty ingredients and chemicals, ColorNet is uniquely positioned to accelerate the adoption of premium bioactive ingredients in Brazil. By connecting innovative global technologies with local market opportunities, and drawing on its deep expertise in specialty ingredients, chemicals, skincare, and personal care, ColorNet serves as a strategic partner in bringing scientifically validated, high-efficacy bioactive solutions to market. Together, we can shape the future of performance-driven, innovation-led beauty and personal care products. | https://www.klkoleo.com/davoslife/wp-content/uploads/2026/09/Davos-ColorNet-Partnership-incosLatam.jpg |

KLK OLEO offers a wide range of products, divided into two sub-families: unsaturated and saturated. TEMEST FC EstersTEMEST FC is a family of products developed by KLK OLEO to support the formulation of food-grade lubricants for use in food processing and packaging environments. The range offers customers a broad selection of base oils, co-base fluids, and additive components suitable for lubricant formulations intended for incidental food contact (NSF HX-1) and direct food contact (NSF 3H) applications, when formulated and used in accordance with applicable NSF requirements. At KLK OLEO, we provide a comprehensive portfolio of premium Mono Esters, each meticulously developed to deliver consistent quality and optimised performance for diverse industrial and cosmetic applications. Polymeric EstersPolymeric Esters are a specialised class of ester lubricants, characterised by their high molecular weight, typically above ISO 100. KLK OLEO offers a wide range of products, divided into two sub-families: unsaturated and saturated. These esters can be utilised as base oils (over 85%), co-base stocks (10-50%), or additives (less than 10%) to enhance physical-chemical properties and tribological performance. When operating in the elasto-hydrodynamic range, they optimise the film layer, resulting in higher energy efficiency and improved overall performance. | image | TEMEST Ester 3 / TEMEST Esters  															 														 								Description: 								TEMEST Esters represent KLK OLEO’s comprehensive portfolio of high‑performance ester‑based lubricants designed to meet the evolving needs of modern industries. Developed from renewable raw materials, the TEMEST range delivers exceptional lubricity, oxidative stability, biodegradability, and versatility across applications such as metalworking fluids, hydraulics, gears, compressors, automotive, food‑grade lubricants, and more. From mono esters to advanced polyol and polymeric esters, each product is engineered to enhance efficiency, reduce wear, and support sustainable, reliable performance in demanding operating environments. 																 								    								 							  							Mono EstersTEMEST Mono Esters are a specialised class of high‑performance ester lubricants, produced through the reaction of a monocarboxylic acid with a monohydric alcohol. Engineered for versatility and reliability, they offer excellent lubricity, stability, and functionality across a wide spectrum of formulations. At KLK OLEO, we provide a comprehensive portfolio of premium Mono Esters, each meticulously developed to deliver consistent quality and optimised performance for diverse industrial and cosmetic applications. Polymeric EstersPolymeric Esters are a specialised class of ester lubricants, characterised by their high molecular weight, typically above ISO 100. KLK OLEO offers a wide range of products, divided into two sub-families: unsaturated and saturated. These esters can be utilised as base oils (over 85%), co-base stocks (10-50%), or additives (less than 10%) to enhance physical-chemical properties and tribological performance. When operating in the elasto-hydrodynamic range, they optimise the film layer, resulting in higher energy efficiency and improved overall performance. TEMEST FC EstersTEMEST FC is a family of products developed by KLK OLEO to support the formulation of food-grade lubricants for use in food processing and packaging environments. The range offers customers a broad selection of base oils, co-base fluids, and additive components suitable for lubricant formulations intended for incidental food contact (NSF HX-1) and direct food contact (NSF 3H) applications, when formulated and used in accordance with applicable NSF requirements. As a result, formulations based on TEMEST FC help extend maintenance intervals, reduce cleaning frequency and associated costs, enhance machinery protection, and improve overall energy efficiency, delivering long-term value and operational reliability in demanding food-processing environments. All this while offering a sustainable profile, with high renewability and biodegradability. | image | TEMEST Ester 3 / TEMEST Esters  															 														 								Description: 								TEMEST Esters represent KLK OLEO’s comprehensive portfolio of high‑performance ester‑based lubricants designed to meet the evolving needs of modern industries. Developed from renewable raw materials, the TEMEST range delivers exceptional lubricity, oxidative stability, biodegradability, and versatility across applications such as metalworking fluids, hydraulics, gears, compressors, automotive, food‑grade lubricants, and more. From mono esters to advanced polyol and polymeric esters, each product is engineered to enhance efficiency, reduce wear, and support sustainable, reliable performance in demanding operating environments. 																 								    								 							  							Mono EstersTEMEST Mono Esters are a specialised class of high‑performance ester lubricants, produced through the reaction of a monocarboxylic acid with a monohydric alcohol. Engineered for versatility and reliability, they offer excellent lubricity, stability, and functionality across a wide spectrum of formulations. At KLK OLEO, we provide a comprehensive portfolio of premium Mono Esters, each meticulously developed to deliver consistent quality and optimised performance for diverse industrial and cosmetic applications. Polymeric EstersPolymeric Esters are a specialised class of ester lubricants, characterised by their high molecular weight, typically above ISO 100. KLK OLEO offers a wide range of products, divided into two sub-families: unsaturated and saturated. These esters can be utilised as base oils (over 85%), co-base stocks (10-50%), or additives (less than 10%) to enhance physical-chemical properties and tribological performance. When operating in the elasto-hydrodynamic range, they optimise the film layer, resulting in higher energy efficiency and improved overall performance. TEMEST FC EstersTEMEST FC is a family of products developed by KLK OLEO to support the formulation of food-grade lubricants for use in food processing and packaging environments. The range offers customers a broad selection of base oils, co-base fluids, and additive components suitable for lubricant formulations intended for incidental food contact (NSF HX-1) and direct food contact (NSF 3H) applications, when formulated and used in accordance with applicable NSF requirements. As a result, formulations based on TEMEST FC help extend maintenance intervals, reduce cleaning frequency and associated costs, enhance machinery protection, and improve overall energy efficiency, delivering long-term value and operational reliability in demanding food-processing environments. All this while offering a sustainable profile, with high renewability and biodegradability. Polymeric EstersPolymeric Esters are a specialised class of ester lubricants, characterised by their high molecular weight, typically above ISO 100. KLK OLEO offers a wide range of products, divided into two sub-families: unsaturated and saturated. These esters can be utilised as base oils (over 85%), co-base stocks (10-50%), or additives (less than 10%) to enhance physical-chemical properties and tribological performance. When operating in the elasto-hydrodynamic range, they optimise the film layer, resulting in higher energy efficiency and improved overall performance. TEMEST FC EstersTEMEST FC is a family of products developed by KLK OLEO to support the formulation of food-grade lubricants for use in food processing and packaging environments. The range offers customers a broad selection of base oils, co-base fluids, and additive components suitable for lubricant formulations intended for incidental food contact (NSF HX-1) and direct food contact (NSF 3H) applications, when formulated and used in accordance with applicable NSF requirements. As a result, formulations based on TEMEST FC help extend maintenance intervals, reduce cleaning frequency and associated costs, enhance machinery protection, and improve overall energy efficiency, delivering long-term value and operational reliability in demanding food-processing environments. All this while offering a sustainable profile, with high renewability and biodegradability. Polymeric EstersPolymeric Esters are a specialised class of ester lubricants, characterised by their high molecular weight, typically above ISO 100. KLK OLEO offers a wide range of products, divided into two sub-families: unsaturated and saturated. These esters can be utilised as base oils (over 85%), co-base stocks (10-50%), or additives (less than 10%) to enhance physical-chemical properties and tribological performance. When operating in the elasto-hydrodynamic range, they optimise the film layer, resulting in higher energy efficiency and improved overall performance. TEMEST FC EstersTEMEST FC is a family of products developed by KLK OLEO to support the formulation of food-grade lubricants for use in food processing and packaging environments. The range offers customers a broad selection of base oils, co-base fluids, and additive components suitable for lubricant formulations intended for incidental food contact (NSF HX-1) and direct food contact (NSF 3H) applications, when formulated and used in accordance with applicable NSF requirements. As a result, formulations based on TEMEST FC help extend maintenance intervals, reduce cleaning frequency and associated costs, enhance machinery protection, and improve overall energy efficiency, delivering long-term value and operational reliability in demanding food-processing environments. All this while offering a sustainable profile, with high renewability and biodegradability. Developed from renewable raw materials, the TEMEST range delivers exceptional lubricity, oxidative stability, biodegradability, and versatility across applications such as metalworking fluids, hydraulics, gears, compressors, automotive, food‑grade lubricants, and more. From mono esters to advanced polyol and polymeric esters, each product is engineered to enhance efficiency, reduce wear, and support sustainable, reliable performance in demanding operating environments. At KLK OLEO, we provide a comprehensive portfolio of premium Mono Esters, each meticulously developed to deliver consistent quality and optimised performance for diverse industrial and cosmetic applications. Polymeric EstersPolymeric Esters are a specialised class of ester lubricants, characterised by their high molecular weight, typically above ISO 100. KLK OLEO offers a wide range of products, divided into two sub-families: unsaturated and saturated. These esters can be utilised as base oils (over 85%), co-base stocks (10-50%), or additives (less than 10%) to enhance physical-chemical properties and tribological performance. When operating in the elasto-hydrodynamic range, they optimise the film layer, resulting in higher energy efficiency and improved overall performance. TEMEST FC EstersTEMEST FC is a family of products developed by KLK OLEO to support the formulation of food-grade lubricants for use in food processing and packaging environments. The range offers customers a broad selection of base oils, co-base fluids, and additive components suitable for lubricant formulations intended for incidental food contact (NSF HX-1) and direct food contact (NSF 3H) applications, when formulated and used in accordance with applicable NSF requirements. As a result, formulations based on TEMEST FC help extend maintenance intervals, reduce cleaning frequency and associated costs, enhance machinery protection, and improve overall energy efficiency, delivering long-term value and operational reliability in demanding food-processing environments. All this while offering a sustainable profile, with high renewability and biodegradability.
