| image | PALMERA Fatty Acids  															 														 								Description: 								PALMERA Fatty Acids, our range of renewable products obtained from vegetable oils through classical oleochemical production processes including distillation and fractionation. Within this range of products we also offer derivatives such as dimer acids, monomer acids, trimer acids and isostearic acids. PALMERA Fatty Acids are being applied for beauty and personal care products, lubricants, metal working, paints, inks, crayons, candles, products for Industries & Institutional (I&I) cleaning, herbicides, biocides, plastics, rubber, textiles and detergents. Manufactured in accordance with legal requirements and quality standards such as GMP+, HACCP and ECOCERT COSMOS, a number of PALMERA Fatty Acids has been made suitable for food, feed, pharmaceutical and personal care applications. 																 								    								 							  							Fractionated Fatty AcidsCaproic Acid  Manufacturing Site: Malaysia, China, Europe Product code: A9806, A9906 Applications: As a flavouring and perfuming agent; Used in production of metalworking fluid to enhance cutting capabilities, grinding capabilities, and rust resistance; Used in production of specialty soaps; As a chain terminator in the production of polyester plasticiser, etc.    Caprylic Acid, Capric Acid, Caprylic-Capric Acid  Manufacturing Site: Malaysia, China, Europe Product code: A5608, A9808, A9908, A9810, A9910 Applications: Used in the production of alkyl chlorides for agricultural products, methyl caprylate/caprate, fatty alcohols, acid chlorides, fatty acid isethionates, metallic soaps, fatty acid sarcosinates, imidazolines, fatty amines, MCT oils, and polyol esters as lubricant in metalworking and as emollient in personal care products, and oxazolines for paint binder ; Used in herbicide, animal feed, corrosion/rust inhibitors for antifreeze, flotation agents in mining, creams and lotion formulations, plasticisers, etc.    Lauric Acid  Manufacturing Site: Malaysia, China, Europe Product code: A4512, A7012, A9212, A9812, A9912 Applications: Used in the production of various esters, fatty alcohols, fatty acid isethionates, metallic soaps, fatty acid sarcosinates, imidazolines, fatty amines, oxazolines for paint binder, surfactants in cosmetics, liquid and transparent soaps; | image | KLK OLEO PALMOCOL Alkanolamides / PALMOCOL Alkanolamides  															 														 								Description: 								PALMOCOL Alkanolamides are high purity ingredients for application in toiletries, liquid detergents and personal care products like shampoos, bubble baths, hand washers, body and facial cleansers. Methyl MonoethanolamidesPalm Kernelamide Methyl MEA / Cocamide Methyl MEA  Product code: PMMA 1300, PMMA 2300 Applications: Excellent alternative product of cocamide diethanolamides (CDEA) and cocamide monoethanolamide (CMEA). | image | PALMERA Glycerine  															 														 								Description: 								PALMERA Refined Glycerine is a high‑purity, colourless, odourless, hygroscopic, and viscous liquid derived from vegetable oils through classical oleochemical processes, including splitting and distillation. Known for its versatility and quality, PALMERA Refined Glycerine is widely used across various industries—tobacco products, surface coatings, paper, inks, lubricants, textiles, urethane polymers, and more. It also serves as a key raw material for producing value‑added chemicals such as propylene glycol, epichlorohydrin, acrolein, and nitroglycerine. Manufactured in compliance with stringent legal and quality standards, including GMP+ and HACCP, several PALMERA Refined Glycerine grades are suitable for use in food, flavours, feed, and personal care applications. Products meeting the specifications of relevant pharmacopoeias are also available for pharmaceutical use. 																 								    								 							  							Refined GlycerineBritish Pharmacopeia (BP)  Manufacturing Site: Malaysia, China Product code: G995B Applications: Used in pharmaceuticals, personal care product, toiletries and cosmetics as solvents and humectants; Food additives; Animal feed; As humidifiers and plasticisers for tobacco.    European Pharmacopeia (EP)  Manufacturing Site: Malaysia, China, Europe Product code: G995E, G9091, G865E Applications: Used in pharmaceuticals, personal care product, toiletries and cosmetics as solvents and humectants; Food additives; Animal feed; As humidifiers and plasticisers for tobacco.    United States Pharmacopeia (USP)  Manufacturing Site: Malaysia, China Product code: G995U, G997U, G9091 Applications: Used in pharmaceuticals, personal care product, toiletries and cosmetics as solvents and humectants; | image | this is an image of a girl helping out with the laundry, and the active cleaning ingredients is Methyl Ester Sulphonate / PALMFONATE Methyl Ester Sulphonates  															 														 								Description: 								PALMFONATE Methyl Ester Sulphonates (MES) is KLK OLEO’s proprietary brand of anionic surfactant, widely recognised as the active cleaning ingredient in laundry detergents. Derived from Methyl Esters of natural fatty acids, this MES surfactant serves as a high-performing, eco-friendly alternative to traditional surfactants like Linear Alkyl Benzene Sulfonate (LABS). Formulated from renewable natural resources, PALMFONATE offers superior detergency, excellent biodegradability, and enhanced calcium hardness tolerance during washing. These qualities make it ideal for both high-efficiency and conventional cleaning applications. PALMFONATE MES is available in multiple formats—free-flowing powder, flakes, and paste—offering formulation flexibility. The powder grade allows for easy, direct post-addition into detergent formulas during manufacturing. As an anionic surfactant, TENSAGEX is widely used as a primary surfactant in rinse-off formulations, including personal care and household cleaning products. Derived from natural fatty alcohols, TENSAGEX is characterised by its high purity and low levels of 1,4-dioxane, salt, and colour, aligning with current regulatory requirements across global markets. To support customers’ sustainability goals, TENSAGEX is also available with RSPO Mass Balance (MB) certification, ensuring responsible sourcing of palm-derived ingredients. We are also proud to announce the launch of our new sustainable ISCC+ certified Ether Sulfates, TENSAGEX MAX series. In the TENSAGEX MAX series, the ethylene oxide content is based on ethylene oxide derived from sustainable raw materials, such as recycled oils or natural oils. | image | Surfactant suppliers / TENSARYL Linear Alkylbenzene Sulphonates & Sulphonic Acids  															 														 								Description: 								The TENSARYL product line consists of linear alkylbenzene sulphonic acids (also known as LABSA) and salts. LABSA and LAS are anionic surfactants that exhibit very good detergent properties for relatively low cost. For this reason, they are considered one of the main work-horses in large volume applications, such as household and industrial laundry and dishwashing detergents, and all-purpose cleaners. Further applications include textile processing and emulsifiers in industrial and agricultural applications. 																 								    								 							  							Linear Alkylbenzene Sulphonic Acid (LABSA)Product: TENSARYL SBLA  Properties/Features: HF LAB, 96% active matter; Viscous liquid   Applications: Laundry, dishwashing, hard surface cleaners, detergent creams/powders, disinfectants, toilet cleaners, car cleaners, paint strippers, emulsion polymerisation.    Product: TENSARYL SBU  Properties/Features: Detal LAB, 96% active matter; Viscous liquid; Low colour   Applications: Laundry, dishwashing, hard surface cleaners, detergent creams/powders, disinfectants, toilet cleaners, car cleaners, paint strippers, emulsion polymerisation. | image | 社区  										在KLK，我们的价值观和关爱文化代代相传，并深植于我们的企业基因中。本着关爱和分享的精神，我们向各个社区的弱势群体伸出援手。我们将努力改善我们业务所在地区的社区生计。 | https://www.klkoleo.com/wp-content/uploads/2020/06/cr-communityt-01-300x200.jpg |
| image | Community / Community 																	 														 								Care for People							 						  													 																	At KLK, our values and the culture of caring continues through the generations and is embedded in our corporate DNA. In the spirit of caring and sharing, we reach out and engage the less fortunate in various communities. We will endeavor to improve the livelihoods of the communities in areas where we operate. | https://www.klkoleo.com/wp-content/uploads/2020/06/cr-communityt-01.jpg |
| image | 教育  					我们相信，教育是积极推动社区未来改变和转型的重要因素。因此，我们寻求在我们开展业务的地区为那些可能无法获得此类机会的人和社区创造适当的教育机会和途径。 | https://www.klkoleo.com/wp-content/uploads/2020/06/cr-education-01-300x200.jpg |
| image | Education / Education 																	 														 								Empowerment Through Education							 						  													 																	We believe that education is an important catalyst for positive change and transform the future of the community. As such, we seek to create appropriate education inroads and pathways in the areas where we operate for people and communities who may not be fortunate enough to have access to such opportunities. | https://www.klkoleo.com/wp-content/uploads/2020/06/cr-education-01.jpg |
| image | 员工  										员工是我们最宝贵的财富之一，他们的健康和福祉仍然是我们的首要任务。我们的目标是支持我们的员工成为最好的人，为他们提供环境和机会，鼓励并使他们过上健康的生活方式。 | https://www.klkoleo.com/wp-content/uploads/2020/06/cr-employeest-01-300x200.jpg |
| image | Employees / Employees 																	 														 								Health and Wellbeing							 						  													 																	Employees are one of our greatest assets and their health and wellbeing remain our top priority. We aim to support our employees to be the best they can be by providing them an environment and opportunities that encourage and enable them to lead a healthy lifestyle. | https://www.klkoleo.com/wp-content/uploads/2020/06/cr-employeest-01.jpg |
| image | 环境  										我们非常重视对环境的保护，这体现在我们的核心业务实践和政策中。我们坚信，我们的生计取决于我们和我们的子孙后代是否拥有一个更健康、更宜居的世界。 | https://www.klkoleo.com/wp-content/uploads/2020/06/cr-environment-01-300x200.jpg |
| image | Environment / Environment 																	 														 								Harmony with Nature							 						  													 																	We place great importance on the protection and preservation of the environment and this is reflected in our core business practices and policies. | image | Press Release: Peng Soon-Liu Ying Receive Support from KLK to Pursue Their Olympic Dream 										07 Nov 2020 										Kuala Lumpur Kepong Berhad (“KLK”), one of the leading plantation companies in Malaysia announces its sponsorship of World rank No 7 Badminton Mixed Doubles, Chan […] 										Know More | https://www.klkoleo.com/wp-content/uploads/2020/11/news-n-events-press-release-20201107-300x300.jpg |
| image | Kuala Lumpur Kepong Berhad (“KLK”), one of the leading plantation companies in Malaysia announces its sponsorship of World rank No 7 Badminton Mixed Doubles, Chan Peng Soon and Goh Liu Ying. The sponsorship, in line with its corporate responsibility effort to promote harmonious culture through sports as well as to support our nation’s pursuit for global sports excellence, it is hoped that the Rio silver medallists duo will continue to bring all Malaysians together and make the country proud when chasing their Tokyo Olympics dream. KLK executive director Lee Jia Zhang said in a statement that, “We understand that the COVID-19 pandemic has changed many of our lives, we are humbled to be able to help ease the financial woes for our Malaysian Mixed Doubles during this difficult period. We hope that with our sponsorship, Peng Soon-Liu Ying can focus and be better prepared for the Games.” The Tokyo Olympics was deferred for one-year to July 23 – Aug 8 in 2021 due to the pandemic. Although Peng Soon-Liu Ying had forgo the two Denmark Opens in October 2020, they are looking at making a return early next year for the two BWF Opens in Asia. The world No. 7 duo need to stay within the top 16 until next year to qualify for Tokyo Olympics 2021. Chan Peng Soon has expressed his gratitude to KLK for the support given to Goh Liu Ying and him. “The deferment of this year’s Olympics also meant that we will need to continue to train to maintain our physical form for another 12 months, in which this will require extra financial expenses. Thank you KLK for coming forward to support us during this difficult time as it is not easy to find support and sponsorship during the COVID-19 pandemic”, said Chan. “The money will help us cover the travel expenses for our future tournaments. We can now focus on qualifying for the Tokyo Olympics and hopefully achieve a better result for Malaysia”, said Liu Ying. Since turning Pro as independent players, Peng Soon-Liu Ying have done well by winning the 2019 Thailand Masters and New Zealand Open. The announcement also sees Peng Soon-Liu Ying become the first brand ambassadors for KLK’s DavosLife E3 Complete, a natural Vitamin E dietary supplement comprising Tocotrienols and alpha tocopherol derived from palm fruits. It is formulated for high bio-absorption and suitable for adults with busy lifestyle and elderly with symptoms of tiredness. Tocotrienols as an antioxidant is beneficial at neutralizing free radicals and may help support overall wellness and vitality and boost healthier body. (From left) Jimmy Yow, Head of Sales and Marketing of KLK OLEO, Goh Liu Ying, Eric Tan, Senior Manager, Sales and Marketing of KLK Land, Chan Peng Soon and Lee Jia Zhang, Executive Director of KLK at the official signing ceremony Apart from continued training, Peng Soon and Liu Ying also taking natural supplements to help increase sport endurance Peng Soon and Liu Ying are the first Brand ambassadors for KLK’s DavosLife E3 Complete, a natural Vitamin E dietary supplement Also featured in The Star and Ipoh Echo. | https://www.klkoleo.com/wp-content/uploads/2020/11/news-n-events-press-release-20201107-img02.jpg |

The announcement also sees Peng Soon-Liu Ying become the first brand ambassadors for KLK’s DavosLife E3 Complete, a natural Vitamin E dietary supplement comprising Tocotrienols and alpha tocopherol derived from palm fruits. It is formulated for high bio-absorption and suitable for adults with busy lifestyle and elderly with symptoms of tiredness. Tocotrienols as an antioxidant is beneficial at neutralizing free radicals and may help support overall wellness and vitality and boost healthier body. (From left) Jimmy Yow, Head of Sales and Marketing of KLK OLEO, Goh Liu Ying, Eric Tan, Senior Manager, Sales and Marketing of KLK Land, Chan Peng Soon and Lee Jia Zhang, Executive Director of KLK at the official signing ceremony Apart from continued training, Peng Soon and Liu Ying also taking natural supplements to help increase sport endurance Peng Soon and Liu Ying are the first Brand ambassadors for KLK’s DavosLife E3 Complete, a natural Vitamin E dietary supplement Also featured in The Star and Ipoh Echo. | https://www.klkoleo.com/wp-content/uploads/2020/11/news-n-events-press-release-20201107-img03-300x210.jpg |

| image | VitaFoods Europe is the leading nutraceutical event of the year, connecting health and nutrition business leaders throughout the entire supply chain. At this year’s VitaFoods Virtual Expo, Davos Life Science will be highlighting a potential new application of Tocotrienols as a bioactive to protect the body from pollution-induced oxidative stress and low-grade chronic inflammation. Research studies have shown that prolonged exposure to environmental air pollution can increase morbidity and mortality. Air pollution induces oxidative stress in skin, lung, vascular and heart tissue, triggering redox-sensitive pathways that lead to biological processes like inflammation and cell death. Davos Life Science will showcase new research data demonstrating how Tocotrienols can reduce oxidative stress and inflammation markers, alongside practical demonstrations of how Tocotrienols can be incorporated into functional foods and beverages, to emphasise the applicability of Tocotrienols as a bioactive for anti-pollution. This will drive product differentiation for businesses to help them answer a growing consumer need. Our sales representatives, Mr. Jimmy Yow and Dr. Sharon Ling will be available for pre-scheduled online meetings (via Vitafoods Virtual Expo platform) throughout 7 to 11 September 2020, so book a slot to talk to them about how Tocotrienols can be incorporated into anti-pollution formulations. We look forward to connect with you! | https://www.klkoleo.com/wp-content/uploads/2021/05/KLK-OLEO-e-invite-to-Vitafoods-Virtual-Expo-2020_Final-1024x725.jpg |

| image | Kuala Lumpur Kepong Berhad (“KLK”), one of the leading plantation companies in Malaysia announces its sponsorship of World rank No 7 Badminton Mixed Doubles, Chan Peng Soon and Goh Liu Ying. The sponsorship, in line with its corporate responsibility effort to promote harmonious culture through sports as well as to support our nation’s pursuit for global sports excellence, it is hoped that the Rio silver medallists duo will continue to bring all Malaysians together and make the country proud when chasing their Tokyo Olympics dream. KLK executive director Lee Jia Zhang said in a statement that, “We understand that the COVID-19 pandemic has changed many of our lives, we are humbled to be able to help ease the financial woes for our Malaysian Mixed Doubles during this difficult period. We hope that with our sponsorship, Peng Soon-Liu Ying can focus and be better prepared for the Games.” The Tokyo Olympics was deferred for one-year to July 23 – Aug 8 in 2021 due to the pandemic. Although Peng Soon-Liu Ying had forgo the two Denmark Opens in October 2020, they are looking at making a return early next year for the two BWF Opens in Asia. The world No. 7 duo need to stay within the top 16 until next year to qualify for Tokyo Olympics 2021. Chan Peng Soon has expressed his gratitude to KLK for the support given to Goh Liu Ying and him. “The deferment of this year’s Olympics also meant that we will need to continue to train to maintain our physical form for another 12 months, in which this will require extra financial expenses. Thank you KLK for coming forward to support us during this difficult time as it is not easy to find support and sponsorship during the COVID-19 pandemic”, said Chan. “The money will help us cover the travel expenses for our future tournaments. We can now focus on qualifying for the Tokyo Olympics and hopefully achieve a better result for Malaysia”, said Liu Ying. Since turning Pro as independent players, Peng Soon-Liu Ying have done well by winning the 2019 Thailand Masters and New Zealand Open. The announcement also sees Peng Soon-Liu Ying become the first brand ambassadors for KLK’s DavosLife E3 Complete, a natural Vitamin E dietary supplement comprising Tocotrienols and alpha tocopherol derived from palm fruits. It is formulated for high bio-absorption and suitable for adults with busy lifestyle and elderly with symptoms of tiredness. Tocotrienols as an antioxidant is beneficial at neutralizing free radicals and may help support overall wellness and vitality and boost healthier body. (From left) Jimmy Yow, Head of Sales and Marketing of KLK OLEO, Goh Liu Ying, Eric Tan, Senior Manager, Sales and Marketing of KLK Land, Chan Peng Soon and Lee Jia Zhang, Executive Director of KLK at the official signing ceremony Apart from continued training, Peng Soon and Liu Ying also taking natural supplements to help increase sport endurance Peng Soon and Liu Ying are the first Brand ambassadors for KLK’s DavosLife E3 Complete, a natural Vitamin E dietary supplement Also featured in The Star and Ipoh Echo. | https://www.klkoleo.com/wp-content/uploads/2021/09/news-n-events-press-release-20201107-img01-600x400.jpg |

| image | KL-Kepong Oleomas Sdn Bhd (“KLKOM”) has successfully added Sodium Lauryl Sulphate (“SLS”) and Sodium Lauryl Ether Sulphate (“SLES”) into their product portfolio since the first quarter (Q1) of 2021. KLKOM is the second SLS and SLES production site of KLK OLEO group after KLK Tensachem, Belgium. The SLS and SLES manufactured by KLKOM are GMP-certified. The addition of these two products makes the offering from KLK OLEO in Asia more complete, especially in the home and personal care industry. Sodium Lauryl Sulphate (TENSOPOL SLS) KLK OLEO produces TENSOPOL SLS with 100% renewable carbon. It is biodegradable, does not bio-accumulate in water or land, and has a natural origin index of 0.9 in accordance with ISO 16128. KLKOM can produce SLS in the form of needles, powder, as well as liquid. SLS is one of the primary surfactants widely used in oral care, personal care and home care. SLS is also an effective surfactant used extensively in industrial applications to make floor cleaners, engine degreasers and machine wash detergents. Toothpaste can also use SLS in a lower concentration.  Sodium Lauryl Ether Sulphate (TENSAGEX SLES) SLES is an anionic surfactant, widely used as a primary surfactant in rinse-off products, such as dishwashing liquid and shampoo. Produced from natural fatty alcohols, TENSAGEX SLES features very high purity and low in 1,4-dioxane, salt and colour. It meets the latest regulatory restrictions for household cleaning products and personal care products. TENSAGEX SLES is available as a high-active paste and also in the form of low active liquid for easy processing.  With state-of-the-art technology to be completed at the end of 2021, SLES with 1 moles EO produced from KLKOM could achieve 1,4 dioxane specs at 5ppm max, which is one of the most stringent specs in the industry. | https://www.klkoleo.com/wp-content/uploads/2021/09/news-n-events-sls-sles-img01-300x107.jpg |

| image | Jaringan KLK OLEO telah berada di 9 negara berbeda di seluruh dunia dengan tenaga kerja lebih dari 3.000 karyawan secara global. Seiring dengan berkembangnya bisnis kami, maka kami percaya bahwa karyawan adalah aset terpenting bagi keberlanjutan dan pertumbuhan bisnis jangka panjang kami; oleh karena itu, kami terus mencari talenta terbaik untuk bergabung menjadi tenaga kerja di perusahaan kami. Berkarier bersama KLK OLEO berarti Anda menjadi bagian dari hal yang istimewa di perusahaan kami. Dengan mengusung Visi dan Nilai Perusahaan, karyawan melaksanakan Misi kami untuk meningkatkan taraf hidup dan memberikan hasil bisnis yang lebih kuat dan efektif. Melalui kerangka kerja pengembangan dan kompetensi karyawan, kami yakin dapat meningkatkan kinerja karyawan dengan cara terbaik dan mendukung kesinambungan rencana bisnis. Kami mencari talenta yang memiliki semangat, energi, antusiasme; dan yang lebih penting, selaras dengan Nilai Utama kami yang terdiri dari Teamwork, Humility, Results, Integrity, Innovation and Loyalty. Bergabunglah dan menjadi bagian dari tim kami, dan kami akan membantu mengembangkan potensi Anda secara penuh. Lihat peluang kerja bersama KLK OLEO melalui saluran berikut:    LinkedIn  talents@klkoleo.com | https://www.klkoleo.com/wp-content/uploads/2021/11/2021-11-19-Karier-Frame.png |
| image | KLK OLEO’s footprint are in 9 different countries across the world with a workforce surpassing 3,000 employees globally. As we continue to expand our business, we believe that employees are of paramount importance to our long-term business sustainability and growth; thus, we continuously seek talents to join our existing workforce.  A career with KLK OLEO means you will be part of something genuinely special. Embracing the Company’s Vision and Values, employees fulfil our Mission to improve more lives and deliver stronger, more effective business results. Through our employee development and competencies framework, we believe in equipping employees with the right tools for their growth and to support the business continuity plan.  We are looking for talents with passion, energy, enthusiasm; and more importantly, aligned to our Core Values of Teamwork, Humility, Results, Integrity, Innovation and Loyalty. Join us, be part of our team, and we will unlock your full potential.    Explore opportunities with KLK OLEO through the following channels:    	 LinkedIn  	 talents@klkoleo.com | https://www.klkoleo.com/wp-content/uploads/2021/11/2021-11-19-frame-work-english-01.png |

| image | His Excellency Mr Pascal Grégoire, Belgium Ambassador to Malaysia, paid a courtesy visit to Palm-Oleo Klang (“POR”) and KL-Kepong Oleomas (“KLKOM”). He was accompanied by Mr Chua Choon Hwa, the Senior Undersecretary of Palm Oil and Sago Development Division from the Ministry of Plantation Industries and Commodities. Palm-Oleo Klang is one of the world’s largest standalone Oleochemical producers. The plant produces PALMERA Fatty Acids and Glycerine; PALMOSALT Soap Noodles; PALMOWAX Fatty Acid Bis-Amides, and a wide range of PALMOCOL Alkanolamides. KL-Kepong Oleomas is strategically located in West Port, Malaysia. This allows direct pipeline access from plant to port for fast and effective supply to international markets. The plant is also one of the world’s largest producers of natural fatty alcohols, producing a wide variety of high-quality oleochemical products. They also invest heavily in R&D in response to the industry’s constant evolution. | https://www.klkoleo.com/wp-content/uploads/2021/11/DSC02311-300x200.jpg |

| image | The King of Belgium has conferred upon the CEO of Kuala Lumpur Kepong Berhad (“KLK”) Tan Sri Dato’ Seri Lee Oi Hian the Commander of the Order of Leopold II during a private ceremony on 26 August 2021. The prestigious National Order was officially presented to Tan Sri Lee on behalf of King Philippe of the Belgians by the Ambassador of Belgium to Malaysia His Excellency Pascal Grégoire. This award is given in honour of KLK Tensachem’s (part of KLK OLEO) transformation and contribution to the Sovereign of Belgium. Tan Sri Lee giving his acceptance speech and looking on is Belgium Ambassador to Malaysia H.E. Pascal Grégoire This Order, which was established on 24 August 1900, is awarded for meritorious service to the Sovereign of Belgium by Royal Decree, as a token of His personal goodwill. According to Mr Ambassador Grégoire, the Order is roughly equivalent to the British Victorian Order, which is a personal gift as well of the British monarch and has similar cases. An ariel view of KLK Tensachem S.A. production site in Ougrée, Belgium It was an honour to have other dignitaries to witness the momentous occasion. Also present at the ceremony was newly appointed Ambassador of Malaysia to Belgium H.E. Dato’ Ahmad Rozian Abd Ghani, Ambassador of the European Union to Malaysia H.E. Mr Michalis Rokas, Berjaya’s Tan Sri Dato’ Seri Vincent Tan and Belgium Embassy’s Deputy Head of Mission Mr Pierrick Massaux. The KLK OLEO team was represented by KLK OLEO CEO Mr Madhev Bala Subramaniam, Managing Director FAL & ME SBU Mr Raghunathan Nair and Managing Director MES Mr Chua Boon Hook. Above from L-R: Ambassador of Malaysia to Belgium H.E. Dato’ Ahmad Rozian Abd Ghani, Tan Sri Lee Oi Hian, Tan Sri Vincent Tan, Belgium Ambassador H.E. Mr. Pascal Grégoire and Ambassador of the European Union to Malaysia H.E. Mr Michalis Rokas. | https://www.klkoleo.com/wp-content/uploads/2021/11/Group1.jpg |

The KLK OLEO team was represented by KLK OLEO CEO Mr Madhev Bala Subramaniam, Managing Director FAL & ME SBU Mr Raghunathan Nair and Managing Director MES Mr Chua Boon Hook. Above from L-R: Ambassador of Malaysia to Belgium H.E. Dato’ Ahmad Rozian Abd Ghani, Tan Sri Lee Oi Hian, Tan Sri Vincent Tan, Belgium Ambassador H.E. Mr. Pascal Grégoire and Ambassador of the European Union to Malaysia H.E. Mr Michalis Rokas. | https://www.klkoleo.com/wp-content/uploads/2021/11/KLK-Tensachem.jpg |
| image | The King of Belgium has conferred upon the CEO of Kuala Lumpur Kepong Berhad (“KLK”) Tan Sri Dato’ Seri Lee Oi Hian the Commander of the Order of Leopold II during a private ceremony on 26 August 2021. The prestigious National Order was officially presented to Tan Sri Lee on behalf of King Philippe of the Belgians by the Ambassador of Belgium to Malaysia His Excellency Pascal Grégoire. This award is given in honour of KLK Tensachem’s (part of KLK OLEO) transformation and contribution to the Sovereign of Belgium. Tan Sri Lee giving his acceptance speech and looking on is Belgium Ambassador to Malaysia H.E. Pascal Grégoire This Order, which was established on 24 August 1900, is awarded for meritorious service to the Sovereign of Belgium by Royal Decree, as a token of His personal goodwill. According to Mr Ambassador Grégoire, the Order is roughly equivalent to the British Victorian Order, which is a personal gift as well of the British monarch and has similar cases. An ariel view of KLK Tensachem S.A. production site in Ougrée, Belgium It was an honour to have other dignitaries to witness the momentous occasion. Also present at the ceremony was newly appointed Ambassador of Malaysia to Belgium H.E. Dato’ Ahmad Rozian Abd Ghani, Ambassador of the European Union to Malaysia H.E. Mr Michalis Rokas, Berjaya’s Tan Sri Dato’ Seri Vincent Tan and Belgium Embassy’s Deputy Head of Mission Mr Pierrick Massaux. The KLK OLEO team was represented by KLK OLEO CEO Mr Madhev Bala Subramaniam, Managing Director FAL & ME SBU Mr Raghunathan Nair and Managing Director MES Mr Chua Boon Hook. Above from L-R: Ambassador of Malaysia to Belgium H.E. Dato’ Ahmad Rozian Abd Ghani, Tan Sri Lee Oi Hian, Tan Sri Vincent Tan, Belgium Ambassador H.E. Mr. Pascal Grégoire and Ambassador of the European Union to Malaysia H.E. Mr Michalis Rokas. | https://www.klkoleo.com/wp-content/uploads/2021/11/KLKs-CEO-Tan-Sri-Dato-Seri-Lee-Oi-Hian-awarded-the-Commander-of-the-Order-of-Leopold-II.jpg |

| image | Cetyl ethylhexanoate is used in beauty and personal care that the women is looking at / PALMESTER Fatty Acid Esters  															 														 								Description: 								PALMESTER Fatty Acid Esters are used in a broad variety of different industrial applications such as cosmetics, toiletries, pharmaceuticals, food, metal working fluids, and etc. Properties like lubrication, mould release, consistency promotion, emolliency, stability enhancement, spreading or fatty, solvency and cleaning demonstrate the large variety of functions offered by these unique products. 																 								    								 							  							Branched Fatty EstersCetyl Ethylhexanoate  Applications: Used in beauty & personal care. Vegetable-base, non-oily with a light silky skin after-feel.    Glyceryl 2-ethylhexanoate  Applications: Used in beauty & personal care. Vegetable-base and provides a non-greasy and cushiony feel.  Butyl EstersN-Butyl Stearate (nBS)  Applications: As biolubricant base oil; Flow promoter/plasticizer for injection molding grades of polystyrene; Lubricant in processing of synthetic fibers; Metalworking lubricant in rolling of aluminum.  Butylene Glycol EstersButylene Glycol Dicaprylate/Dicaprate  Applications:An emollient and skin conditioning agent for beauty and personal care products.  Ethylhexyl EstersEthylhexyl Cocoate (EHC)  Applications: Fatty acid ester derived from coconut fat with softening properties, non-occlusive and fine emollient.    Ethylhexyl Oleate (EHO)  Applications: As biolubricant base oil; Solvent for antibiotics and vitamins; After epoxidation as low temperature plasticizer for PVC; After sulphurisation as high pressure additive for lubricants.    Ethylhexyl Stearate (EHS)  Applications: As biolubricant base oil; Offers good lubricity and low volatility as component of specialized textile fiber dressings; Can be used in carbon stencil manufacture and pigment carrier in printing inks; Better clean burn and minimal stain for cold rolling than tallow.    Ethylhexyl Palmitate (EHP)  Applications: As biolubricant base oil; Can be used to replace mineral oil; For night cream, hand cream, cleansing lotion, baby cream & massage lotion.  Glyceryl EstersTriacetin  Applications: Plasticizer for cigarette filters; Solvent for flavorings; General purpose food additive; Ester catalyst/curing agent in sand casting; Raw material for food ester (e.g. Acetylated Monoglycerides); Plasticizer for adhesive, and etc.    Glycerol Trioleate  Applications: As biolubricant base oil; Lubricant component of synthetic fibre finishes. Replacement of a variety of natural oils. Synthetic oil for fat liquor production.    Caprylic / Capric Triglyceride  Applications: Caprylic Capric Triglyceride (also known as MCT oils) can be used for animal feed and agricultural application; Inert carrier for flavor, oil soluble food colorants, fat soluble vitamins and fat soluble additives. Manufactured to the best bland taste for flavoring agents, to ensure excellent keeping qualities and compatibility with sensitive flavors. Superb colorless properties for transparency and enhancing natural color; Miscible in more polar solvents such as alcohols, even in the presence of water; Good spreading properties for bakeries coating, mould release and lubricating production transport system; The superb color & odor makes it a good emollient for cosmetics & toiletries; Standard grade, produced to colorless, odorless and bland taste for food applications.  Glycol EstersGlycol Stearate  Applications: Pearlescing agent.    Glycol Distearate  Applications: Pearlescing agent.  Isopropyl EstersIsopropyl Oleate (IPO)  Applications: As biolubricant base oil; Hydrolytically stable, medium oxidative stability; Can be used in concrete waterproofing agent.    Isopropyl Laurate (IPL)  Applications: As biolubricant base oil; Use in ink industries.    Isopropyl Palmitate (IPP)  Applications: The standard polar emollient for cosmetic and toiletries use.    Isopropyl Myristate (IPM)  Applications: The polar emollient produced to stringent odor and color standards special for fragrance use and for excellent keeping qualities; As biolubricant base oil; Can be used in metal working.    Isopropyl Stearate (IPS)  Applications: A fast spreading emollient suitable for all beauty and cosmetics applications.  IsostearatesIsopropyl Isostearate (IPIS)  Applications: Ideal for heat sensitive personal care formulations. It enables superior odour and colour end-products. It also exhibits excellent skin feel without feel of greasiness. It is widely used in colour cosmetics, bath oil, skin and hair care.    Pentaerytritol Tetraisostearate (PTIS)  Applications: Ideal for heat sensitive personal care formulations. It enables superior odour and colour end-products. It also exhibits excellent skin feel without feel of greasiness. It is widely used in colour cosmetics, bath oil, skin and hair care.  Methyl EstersMethyl Laurate  Applications: As biolubricant base oil; Lubricity additive in the production of aluminum metal working fluids; Paint and ink additives.  Neopentyl Glycol EstersNeopentyl Glycol Dioleate  Applications: Used as biolubricant base oil and additive for metal working fluid and rolling oil.  Pentaerythritol EstersPentaerythritol Tetracaprylate/Tetracaprate  Applications: As biolubricant base oil; Used in metal working & industrial chain & greases; Ideal lubricant component for spin finish; Lubricity additive in formulation of high temperature metalworking fluids; Used in hair conditioners, cream and lotions, sunscreens and bath oil with functional properties of skin conditioning agent, occlusive agent and emollient.    Pentaerythritol Tetraoleate  Applications: As biolubricant base oil; in formulation of high temperature metal working fluids.    Pentaerythritol Tetrastearate (PETS)  Applications: PETS is typical used as internal and external lubricant for plastic industry. It is well match with polycarbonate, but also in PA, PET and other plastics. Besides, PETS also function as mould release agent with low volatility and suitable for high transparent product. Dosage recommendation up to 0.5% in plastic article is able to remain product transparent property and colour stability.  Propylene Glycol EstersPropylene Glycol Dicaprylate/Dicaprate  Applications: Solvent, vehicle, diluent, carrier for flavors and fragrance oils, colorants, vitamines, medicinals, cosmetics; Emollients for cosmetics, pharmaceuticals, creams/lotions; Food additives; Used in resinous/polymeric food-contact coatings; Defoamer in food-contact paper/paperboard; As biolubricant base oil.    Propylene Glycol Dioleate  Applications: Biodegradable hydraulic fluids, low pour point lubricity additive in many different types of lubricant.  Trimethylolpropane EstersTrimethylolpropane Caprate/Caprylate  Applications: As biolubricant base oil; Used in metal working, automotive, engine oils & industrial air compressor; Good thermal and oxidative stability.    Trimethylolpropane Trioleate  Applications: As biolubricant base oil; Used in fire resistant & biodegradable hydraulic fluids and metal working. Low pour point with excellent lubricity & oxidation stability. High flash point hydraulic fluids.    Trimethylolpropane Palm Cocoate  Applications: As biolubricant base oil; Used in metal working, as rolling fluids and textile lubricants; Good clean burn properties and enhanced lubricity for high temperature applications.    Trimethylolpropane Palm Kernelate  Applications: As biolubricant base oil; Used in metal working, as rolling fluids and textile lubricants; Good clean burn properties and enhanced lubricity for high temperature applications.  Wax EstersCetyl Palmitate  Applications: An emollient that lubricates and conditions the skin’s surface, helping it to appear softer and smoother. It is also used as a surfactant in shampoos, and as an emulsifier and thickening agent in various lotions and creams. It helps add texture various makeup products. Great skin-conditioning ingredient, also used as occlusive and masking ingredient, enhances emulsion stability, excellent film former, reduces greasy feel of oil systems, improves payoff characteristics in stick cosmetics.    Decyl Oleate  Applications: Used in a variety of cosmetics and personal care products, including makeup, and skin and hair care products; Acts as a lubricant on the skin surface, which gives the skin a soft and smooth appearance It forms a thin film on the skin that is neither greasy nor tacky. Its unique properties facilities the application and removal of makeup. | image | Fatty acid amides includes oleyl palmitatmide, EBS wax that is used as anti block agents in plastic coatings, inks and rubber. / PALMOWAX Fatty Acid Bis-Amides  															 														 								Description: 								KLK OLEO’s range of fatty acid amides includes high-purity ingredients such as Oleyl Palmitamide, Ethylene Bis-Stearamide (EBS), and Ethylene Bis-Oleamide (EBO) under the PALMOWAX brand. These versatile compounds serve as slip agents, dispersants, and anti-block agents across multiple industries including plastics, coatings, inks, and rubber. As a trusted EBS supplier, we provide EBS wax and EBO in forms suitable for both internal and external lubrication of plastics such as ABS, PS, and PP. PALMOWAX also functions as a binder in precision metal engineering applications.  Its excellent surface migration and dispersion properties make it valuable in ink formulations, while its addition to asphalt enhances viscoelasticity and raises the softening point—ideal for road construction. For even greater formulation flexibility, these fatty acid amides can be paired with our polymer additives or fatty acid esters to enhance thermal stability and processing efficiency in complex systems. 																 								    								 							  							Ethylene Bis-StearamideEthylene Bis-Stearamide (EBS)  Product code: Atomised; 1% ≤ on 325 meshBead; 15% ≤ on 10 meshSF; 85% ≥ pass 200 meshSP; 90% ≥ pass 16 meshSR; 90% ≥ pass 16 mesh  Applications: EBS is widely used in plastic industry as internal/external lubricants, mold releasing aids, dispersants and slip agents; As dispersants in printing inks; Increase softening point in asphalt modifiers; As lubricants in powder metal molding, rubber, adhesive, coatings, wire drawing, wood plastic composite; As defoamers in paper.  Ethylene Bis-OleamideEthylene Bis-Oleamide (EBO)  Product code: SPO; 90% ≥ pass 16 mesh  Applications: EBO is an excellent lubricant in plastic Applicationss especially in styrenic polymer such as PS and ABS to help with polymer flow, mould release and anti-caking properties of the polymer; Also widely used as anti-blocking agents in PVC film and sheet. | image | this is an image of a girl washing her hands using a hand soap that uses sympare MES that is a sustainable ingredient for personal care. / Sympare Methyl Ester Sulphonates  															 														 								Description: 								Sympare Methyl Ester Sulphonates (MES) is a sulphate-free anionic surfactant naturally made from plant source for use in the personal care categories. Sympare MES is listed in the CleanGredients database as it meets the EPA’s Safer Choice Standard. It is a sustainable alternative to petroleum-based surfactants in cleansing product formulations where product’s low irritation and mildness are benefits. Sympare MES contains more than 50% of natural raw materials and is defined as derived natural ingredient according to ISO 16128. It is a suitable alternative ingredient recommended for high-growth natural consumer product categories such as baby care, personal care, and cosmetics. | image | KLK received Company of the Year Award for Leadership in Community,  Education, Scholarship & Welfare 										30 Nov 2021 										KLK was selected as a recipient for the CSR Malaysia’s Company of the Year Award for Leadership in Community, Education, Scholarship and Welfare in the […] 										Know More | https://www.klkoleo.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/01/2021-CSR-Award-01.png |
| image | KLK was selected as a recipient for the CSR Malaysia’s Company of the Year Award for Leadership in Community, Education, Scholarship and Welfare in the Sustainability & CSR Malaysia Awards 2021.  Organised by CSR Malaysia, the annually held awards initiative is a platform to celebrate outstanding achievers and inspire corporations for their efforts to create a better Malaysia through their sustainability and corporate social responsibility venture. This is KLK’s second recognition from CSR Malaysia, as last year we received the Award for Sustainability & CSR Excellence (Plantation). The recipients were selected by an esteemed panel of judges representing media and social bodies. Judging criteria for the awards were based on the company’s clear purpose and goals in their CSR initiative, together with the impact created, and frequency of CSR events held. Find out more about KLK’s Corporate Responsibility here: Values Matter. Society Matters. | https://www.klkoleo.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/01/Receive-Award.png |
| image | Palm-Oleo Sdn Bhd (Palm-Oleo) has recently won the Malaysian Society for Occupational Safety and Health (MSOSH) Gold Class I Award in the MSOSH Award 2021. The award-giving ceremony was held on 25 November 2021 at Majestic Hotel, Kuala Lumpur. Palm-Oleo participated in the MSOSH Award 2021 programme held between August to September 2021. The main objective of Palm-Oleo’s participation was to gauge the level of occupational safety & health standard, practice and culture currently in place at Palm-Oleo.  MSOH Award was also participated by several major oil and gas companies which were widely known for their high compliance in safety & health standards. With this win, it is heartening to note that Palm-Oleo is sharing the same platform in terms of SHE reputation along with these established multi-national companies. This recognition is in line with KLK Group’s aim to continuously practice and support the Group’s safety & health programme to ensure a better and safer workplace for all. Palm-Oleo team posing with the Gold Class 1 plaque & trophy | https://www.klkoleo.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/05/20211125_133213-e-scaled.jpg |

| image | Let’s connect at Vitafoods Europe 2022! As a global player in oleochemicals and phytonutrients, KLK OLEO offers an array of high quality, natural and sustainable products. We supply bioactives for use in nutraceuticals, cosmeceuticals and functional food and beverages. We also supply specialty ingredients for food and nutrition applications. At this year’s Vitafoods Europe, we will feature DavosLife E3 Tocotrienols for beauty from within applications. We have received glowing reviews from customers who have tried and tested DavosLife E3 Bio-Enhanced 20 and DavosLife E3 DVP 30-WD in beauty from within nutraceutical products. Customers saw marked improvements in skin tone and youthfulness in 2 months. Look for us at Booth no. G49 to understand how KLK OLEO can help you elevate your products. We will showcase various products at this event: ✔️ DavosLife E3 Tocotrienols (Super Vitamin E) ✔️ DavosLife Biocarotene ✔️ PALMESTER MCTs ✔️ PALMERA Glycerine ✔️ EDENOR Triacetin ✔️ ENHEX MCTs (Ph. Eur. Grade) ✔️ ENHEX Glycerine (Ph. Eur. Grade) | https://www.klkoleo.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/05/KLK-OLEO-e-invite-to-VFE-2022-B.jpg |

| image | KLK OLEO announces today the appointment of Ralf Ewering as Chief Sustainability Officer Europe. Ralf will drive and lead the development and delivery of the Europe region’s sustainability strategy to further establish KLK OLEO’s sustainability leadership in the Oleochemical industry. “I’m excited to further drive momentum to KLK OLEO’s sustainability journey and work on the positive transition of our industry towards the people and our planet.” Ralf Ewering said. Ralf has 27 years of experience in different managerial positions in the process industry and is working for 17 years in the oleochemical industry. Ralf holds a Master in Chemical Engineering from the Technical University of Dortmund. At KLK OLEO, our principles on sustainability are guided by integrity. Sustainability is fundamental to how we conduct our business and we have a robust structure in place to facilitate the implementation of sustainability strategies across the Group. Our commitment to ESG (Environmental, Social and Governance) and Sustainability Policy enable KLK OLEO continues to grow as the most trusted partner in sustainable products and solutions. About KLK OLEO Built on a legacy of integrity, humility, innovation and loyalty, KLK OLEO is committed to providing the best sustainable solutions to address global demands and consumer trends. As a worldwide oleochemical producer with over 100 years of experience, KLK OLEO’s products can be found in most consumer staples, from Beauty & Personal Care, Food & Health Care, Home Care, Industries & Institutional Cleaning, Lubricants to Polymers. KLK OLEO is the manufacturing division of KUALA LUMPUR KEPONG BERHAD (KLK). A leading international Plantations group listed on the Main Board of Bursa Malaysia Securities Berhad. | https://www.klkoleo.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/06/Ralf-Ewering-100x100.jpg |

| image | KLK’s CEO, Tan Sri Dato’ Seri Lee Oi Hian was named The Edge Billion Ringgit Club (BRC) 2022’s Outstanding CEO & Value Creator in an awards ceremony held at Shangri-La Hotel, Kuala Lumpur.  The gala dinner and awards ceremony was graced by caretaker Finance Minister Tengku Datuk Seri Zafrul Abdul Aziz. In his welcome speech last night, The Edge Media Group Chairman, Tan Sri Tong Kooi Ong hoped the BRC awards will bring out the best in every Malaysian company and its management. The awards were given based on genuine merit, with its methodology and evaluation criteria being transparent, verifiable and independently audited. Currently in its 13th year, Tan Sri Tong also hoped that as the BRC awards continue to evolve, business sustainability will also be a factor in the future. This too, was a sentiment that Tengku Zafrul echoed in his keynote address especially in creating a more sustainable and resilient economy by embracing the environmental, social and governance (ESG) principles. Tan Sri Lee Oi Hian paid tribute to our Founder Chairman to whom he attributed his success and that of KLK’s, as having benefitted from the values laid down by the late Tan Sri Lee Loy Seng. “I am humbled by this award because this is only possible through the help of many, including the Almighty God. We have to remain consistent, continue our journey based on values,” Tan Sri Lee Oi Hian said after accepting Malaysia’s Outstanding CEO & Value Creator Award. KLK was also recognised in two other categories – Highest Growth in Profit After Tax Over Three Years in the Big Cap Companies (RM10 billion to RM40 billion Market Capitalisation) category and Highest Growth in Profit After Tax Over Three Years in the Plantation category. The awards were accepted on behalf of KLK by Mr. Lee Guo Zhang and Mr. Patrick Ng Chuan Peng respectively. | image | KLK OLEO EEA Stage / KLK OLEO received the “Thriving in Adversity” Award at the Export Excellence Awards (EEA) Gala Night held on 25th November 2022 at M Resort and Hotel in Kuala Lumpur. Organised by The Star Media Group, EEA celebrates “the best of the best” in the export world. It honours the excellence of homegrown businesses in export and targets to build a community of Malaysian exporters that excels through healthy competition and support of one another. The award was accepted by Mr. Siew Fook Ming, Deputy CEO, on behalf of KLK OLEO. The award honours KLK OLEO’s efforts and tremendous resilience while navigating global headwinds and demonstrating excellence by thriving in adversity during the Covid-19 crisis.  During the peak of Covid-19 pandemic, KLK OLEO as an approved essential industry, sustained efforts to maintain operations on units of demand, without compromising the health and wellbeing of the staffs – an invaluable asset. It clustered as a unified team, exercising multiple controls in curbing the spread of Covid-19, while operating on key areas of demand. A Covid-19 task force comprising senior management, working closely with its people, was formed across all its sites. This award will prove as a catalyst for KLK OLEO to continue excelling in the Malaysian palm oil and oleochemical industry. | image | Ms Lim Fong Nee and Dr. Liew Weng Hui received the MSOSH trophy and plaque - KLK OLEO / Palm-Oleo Sdn Bhd (Palm-Oleo) Fatty Acid & Glycerine (FAG) Plant and Soap Noodle & Amide (SNAM) Plant were both awarded the MSOSH Gold Class I Award. On 21st December 2022, the Malaysian Society of Occupational Safety & Health (MSOSH) held the spectacular event at the Sunway Resort Hotel. Both plant delegations were led by their respective General Managers, Dr. Liew Weng Hui and Ms. Lim Fong Nee. While FAG Plant has achieved this feat for the second year in a row, it is significant this year that SNAM Plant has participated and stands tall together to represent KLK OLEO in an event attended by other leading oil and gas, utility, and chemical producer companies in Malaysia. Ms Lim Fong Nee and Dr. Liew Weng Hui received the MSOSH trophy and plaque The primary goal of Palm-Oleo’s participation in this yearly event is to assess and improve the current level of occupational safety and health standards, practises, and culture at Palm-Oleo. As a result, we can rest assured that Palm-Oleo is currently on the right path toward SHE excellence. This recognition is in line with KLK Group’s aim to continuously practice and support the Group’s safety & health programme to ensure a better and safer workplace for all. Palm-Oleo team posing with both Gold Class I plaques & trophies | https://www.klkoleo.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/01/Palm-Oleo-Awarded-MSOSH-Gold-Class-I-Award-01.png |
| image | KLK OLEO acquires Italian ester producer Temix Oleo / Acquisition will expand KLK OLEOs’ product offering for Oleochemical. Milan, Italy and Emmerich, Germany – Temix Oleo SpA (“Temix Oleo”) and KLK Emmerich GmbH (“KLKE”), a subsidiary of Kuala Lumpur Kepong Berhad (“KLK”), under its resource-based manufacturing division known as KLK OLEO, has entered into a definitive agreement to acquire a controlling stake in Temix Oleo (“the Transaction”). KLK OLEO is a global integrated oleochemical producer (oleochemical, derivatives and specialty chemicals) with manufacturing sites in Malaysia, Indonesia, China, and Europe. KLK OLEO is the manufacturing division of KLK, a leading international plantations group listed on the Malaysia stock exchange with a market capitalisation of approximately Euro 4.8 billion as at the end of September 2022. Temix Oleo is an oleochemical company focused on production of Esters mainly based on renewable feed stocks, and delivering solutions for lubricant, cosmetic, ceramic, coating, rubber and plastics industries. Temix Oleo is located in Milan, Italy with production plant in Calderara di Reno (Bologna) employing around 100 people with a turnover of Euro 150 million in 2022. The Transaction is expected to be completed by April 2023, subject to regulatory approval and customary closing conditions. “Temix Oleo outstanding reputation is built on their customer-centric and high-quality service business model. We are excited to welcome the Temix Oleo team and their excellent product portfolio to be part of the group of KLK (“KLK Group”)” said Sriganesh Mathur Subramanian, Managing Director, KLKE. “This acquisition is an opportunity for Temix Oleo to continue to grow, in product portfolio and geographic areas, with focus on sustainability and innovation. Being part of the KLK Group, employees can look forward to a bright future.“ said Roberto Cella, Managing Director Temix Oleo. For more information, please visit www.klkoleo.com/klkemmerich and www.temixoleo.com KLK OLEO to acquire Italian Ester Producer Temix Oleo | https://www.klkoleo.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/03/KLK-OLEO-acquires-Italian-ester-producer-Temix-Oleo.png |

The awards ceremony was held on Thursday, 13 July at EQ Kuala Lumpur.  Receiving the award on behalf of KLK, Group COO Mr. Lee Jia Zhang said, “KLK’s journey started over a hundred years ago. Results or excellence has always been a core value of our company. This has been instilled from our Founder Chairman Tan Sri Lee Loy Seng, to now our CEO Tan Sri Lee Oi Hian. We are constantly reminded about stewardship, responsibility and doing things the right way. This is our duty to our people and to the communities around us. Only when we are strong can the company continue to grow, and in return, they can continue to have stability and thrive. This is only made possible with our commitment to excellence and pursuit of innovation.” Also present at the ceremony were KLK Director Ms. Cheryl Khor, Group Chief Financial Officer Mr. William Ong, Head of Corporate Mr. Teh Kwan Wey, and Head of Treasury Ms. Tanya Lee. | image | KLK OLEO for POC 2023 Certificate / In line with our sustainability commitment and in conjunction with the Palm & Lauric Price Outlook Conference (POC), KLK OLEO partnered with APE Malaysia (Animal Projects & Environmental Education Sdn. Bhd.) and planted 200 trees in the lower Kinabatangan River Wildlife Sanctuary in Sabah, Malaysia. These trees are to reconnect the forest corridors that serve as habitats for endangered animals. The following trees were planted on plot 05°27’20.56″ E118°14’24.37″.    Tree Species Number of Trees     Bangkal (Neonauclea subdita) 66   Talisai Paya (Terminalia copelandii) 36   Medang 3 Urat (Cinamomom sp) 10   Fig (Ficus sp) 9   Lamba (Colona seratifolia) 6   Simpoh Laki (Dillenia excelsa) 30   Obah Jangkang (Eugenia cerassiformis) 1   Tangkol Merah (Ficus sp) 1   Pulai (Alstonia sp) 3   Medang (Litsea sp) 2   Bayor (Pterospermum elongatum) 36   TOTAL 200    These trees will reach 5m in height in just 5 years and will converge with the rest of the trees to form the forest canopy in less than 10 years. We hope to hear gibbons and birds singing, monkeys swinging from tree to tree, and possibly an orangutan nesting high in the trees! APE will provide updates on its reforestation site on their social media platforms, including Facebook, Twitter, Instagram or Youtube.  Plant more trees to keep the Earth healthy. Save the environment to save your future. | https://www.klkoleo.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/07/KLK-Oleo-for-POC-2023-Certificate.png |

| image | Temix Oleo Acquisition Group Picture / Acquisition expands KLK OLEO’s product offering for Oleochemicals KLK Emmerich GmbH (“KLKE”) a subsidiary of Kuala Lumpur Kepong Berhad (“KLK”), under its resource-based manufacturing division known as KLK OLEO, has recently completed its acquisition of a controlling stake in Temix Oleo SpA (“Temix Oleo”) for an undisclosed sum. The transaction was completed after receiving all necessary approvals and fulfilling all customary closing conditions. “We are thrilled to have completed this acquisition and to welcome the talented team from Temix Oleo to the KLK group. This acquisition is aligned with our long-term strategy and vision for growth by further diversifying our product offering, increasing access to key customers and augmenting our product specialisation strategy across our European operations,” said Uwe Halder, CEO, KLK OLEO Europe. “We are excited to join forces with KLK OLEO and bring our unique capabilities and expertise to the table. We are confident that this merger will be beneficial for all parties involved and will create new opportunities for growth and innovation,” said Roberto Cella, Managing Director of Temix Oleo. KLK OLEO is a global integrated oleochemical producer (oleochemical, derivatives and specialty chemicals) with manufacturing sites in Malaysia, Indonesia, China, and Europe. KLK OLEO is the manufacturing division of KLK, a leading international plantations group listed on the Malaysia stock exchange with a market capitalisation of approximately 4.7 Mrd. € as at the end of September 2022. Temix Oleo is an oleochemical company focused on production of Esters mainly based on renewable feed stocks, and delivering solutions for lubricant, cosmetic, ceramic, coating, rubber and plastics industries. Based in Milan, Italy, Temix Oleo has a production plant in Calderara di Reno, Bologna, with over 100 employees and a turnover of 150 Mio. € in 2022. KLKE has been assisted by KPMG Italy as financial advisor and for the financial and tax due diligences. Hogan Lovells, Italian practice, acted as legal advisor for the legal matters. Temix Oleo has been assisted by LCA Studio Legale for the legal matters. For more information, please visit www.klkoleo.com/klkemmerich and www.temixoleo.com (From left) Dr. Bors Cajus Abele, Managing Director KLKE, Marco Galateri di Genola, Sagittario S.p.A., Roberto Cella, Managing Director Temix Oleo SpA, Lee Jia Zhang, KLK Group Chief Operating Officer, Piero Rinaldi, S.A.P.I. – Società Azionaria Prodotti Industriali – S.p.A. and Uwe Halder, CEO KLK Oleo Europe, after the signing ceremony on 31 March 2023. | https://www.klkoleo.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/07/Temix-Oleo-Acquisition-Group-Picture.jpg |

| image | Global CSR & ESG Awards 2023 / KLK Group has achieved remarkable success at the 15th Annual Global CSR & ESG Summit and Awards, held on August 29th, 2023 in Danang, Vietnam. | image | First rooftop solar PV system in KLK OLEO / Electricity is a key element in KLK OLEO’s manufacturing process and contributes significantly to process costs and greenhouse gas emissions. In 2022, the Group decided to invest in a rooftop solar photovoltaic (PV) system at Palm-Oleo (Klang) Sdn Bhd (POK). The solar PV system produces electricity that is environmentally friendly and sustainable by harnessing the sun’s energy. A total of 1,576 monocrystalline solar PV modules were installed on available rooftops, including warehouses, loading bays and offices. Through the installation, POK can generate 1 GWh of renewable energy each year, about 5% of its electricity usage. This system is one of KLK OLEO’s increased efforts to reducing greenhouse gas emissions and achieving Net Zero. The new solar PV system has played a role in reducing greenhouse gas emissions | https://www.klkoleo.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/09/MicrosoftTeams-image-42.jpg |

| image | DavosLife E3 full range FSSC 22000 Certification / Davos Life Science is proud to announce our achievement in the Food Safety System Certification 22000 (FSSC 22000). This achievement signifies our unwavering commitment to delivering the highest standards of food safety to our customers. FSSC 22000 is an ISO-based food safety management scheme recognised by the Global Food Safety Initiative (GFSI), it meets the highest standards globally, leading to international food industry acceptance. This certification not only benefits our customers by guaranteeing the safety and quality of Davos Life Science products, but also reinforces the company’s position as a trusted leader in the industry. Davos Life Science is proud of this accomplishment and remains committed to exceeding industry standards in food safety. We will continue to invest in our food safety management system and strive to deliver the highest quality products to our customers every time. About Davos Life Science Davos Life Science is one of the leading market players in producing high quality Tocotrienols and Mixed Carotenes from non-GMO palm fruits, sourced directly from RSPO-certified plantations. Tocotrienols have 60x more antioxidative potency compared to α-tocopherol with strong anti-inflammatory properties. DavosLife E3 Tocotrienols are bioactive ingredients for dietary supplements, functional food and beverages, cosmetic and personal care products. | image | KLK Malaysia’s Best Managed Companies in 2024 Collage / KLK has once again been recognised as one of Malaysia’s Best Managed Companies in 2024. This marks the third consecutive year we have received this honour, reflecting our Company’s organisational success and contributions to the industry. The awards ceremony took place on 22 August, at Le Meridien Kuala Lumpur. This year was particularly special, as KLK’s Executive Chairman, Tan Sri Lee Oi Hian was invited to be a guest speaker to share his insights on “Empowering the Next Generation for Business.” Tan Sri Lee paid tribute to his father, the late Founder Chairman Tan Sri Lee Loy Seng, during his speech. He shared his experience as a second-generation leader and how he continued to build upon his father’s legacy. Additionally, he highlighted Tan Sri Lee Loy Seng’s subtle yet impactful mentorship and shared three valuable lessons:   Core Values: “Integrity, humility, loyalty.” Values that Tan Sri Lee Loy Seng lived by, which continue to guide KLK’s dominant culture of T.H.R.I.I.L.  Purpose in life: Finding fulfilment in life goes beyond wealth. It’s about creating a compassionate environment that impacts KLK’s 50,000 employees and their families. Tan Sri Lee Loy Seng reminded us to be good stewards of our stakeholders. Fulfilling this stewardship brings true contentment to life. Balancing work and family: His ability to manage the demands of running a business while fostering family unity and solidarity.    KLK’s COO, Mr. Lee Jia Zhang, accepted the award on behalf of KLK. Ms. Lee Wen Ling, Managing Director of KLK Land, was also invited onstage to answer a few questions about the win. When asked about the perception of the plantation industry as being part of the “old economy,” Ms. Lee responded: “I believe this view is inaccurate. As consumers become more conscious, there is a growing demand for sustainably produced products. To stay ahead, we must continue exploring and adapting, going beyond sustainability certifications to focus on areas like decarbonisation and traceability, among others.” Also present at the award gala dinner were KLK Head of Corporate Mr. Teh Kwan Wey and Sustainability & Special Projects AGM Mr. Adrian Tan. About KLK OLEO Built on a legacy of integrity, humility, innovation and loyalty, KLK OLEO is committed to providing the best sustainable solutions to address global demands and consumer trends. As a worldwide oleochemical producer with over 100 years of experience, KLK OLEO’s products can be found in most consumer staples, from Beauty & Personal Care, Food & Health Care, Home Care, Industries & Institutional Cleaning, Lubricants to Polymers. KLK OLEO is the manufacturing division of KUALA LUMPUR KEPONG BERHAD (KLK). A leading international Plantations group listed on the Main Board of Bursa Malaysia Securities Berhad. | https://www.klkoleo.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/10/Collage.jpg |

| image | Press Release: KLK renews support to Malaysian Mixed Doubles Stars Goh Soon Huat and Shevon Lai / Kuala Lumpur Kepong Berhad (“KLK” or the “Group”) is proud to announce the renewal of our sponsorship for Malaysia’s national badminton mixed doubles pair, Goh Soon Huat and Shevon Lai, through 2025. This renewal reflects KLK’s continued commitment to support local sporting talent and fostering national pride. Since 2023, KLK has been a proud supporter of the pair, who have made remarkable strides on the international stage. In addition to renewing their sponsorship, KLK has extended support to their coach, Teo Kok Siang, ensuring the team has the resources to excel in the coming year. As part of this partnership, Goh Soon Huat and Shevon Lai will also serve as KLK Brand Ambassadors for DavosLife Science products, including DavosLife E3 Complete Tocotrienols and Revive Skin Care BeauE Collagen. Commenting on the partnership, KLK Chief Operating Officer, Lee Jia Zhang said, “We are incredibly proud of Goh Soon Huat and Shevon Lai for their dedication and outstanding performance over the past year. Their perseverance and sportsmanship are inspiring and we wish them the very best as they compete in the upcoming PETRONAS Malaysia Open and the 2025 season.” Goh Soon Huat and Shevon Lai expressed their heartfelt gratitude for KLK’s continued support, saying “Our journey as independent players has been challenging, yet incredibly rewarding. Securing funding and meeting our tournament commitments has been a significant hurdle. KLK’s unwavering trust in our potential, regardless of outcomes, has been empowering. This partnership has not only boosted our confidence but has also provided us the stability to focus on our performance and represent Malaysia with pride.” Looking ahead, the duo shared their ambitious goals: “Our immediate target for the PETRONAS Malaysia Open is to advance to the quarterfinals. Beyond that, we aim to refine our performance, maintain consistency and break into the world’s top five rankings. In 2024, we came close to securing a Super 1000 championship title in China but narrowly missed it. For 2025 we are motivated to achieve that milestone.” KLK looks forward to celebrate more milestones with Goh Soon Huat and Shevon Lai as they continue to thrive and make Malaysia proud in the 2025 season. KLK Chief Operating Officer Mr. Lee Jia Zhang (centre) with Shevon Lai (left) and Goh Soon Huat (right) at the signing ceremony recently Also featured in The Star. | https://www.klkoleo.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/01/DSC_3698.jpg |

| image | KLK OLEO KLKOI / KLK OLEO is pleased to announce the expansion of our business operations in India by establishing a new representative office – KLK OLEO India (KLKOI) in Mumbai. As a global leader in oleochemical production, we offer a diverse portfolio ranging from basic oleochemical products, such as Fatty Acids, Glycerine, Fatty Alcohols and Fatty Esters, all the way down the spectrum to specialties, such as Methyl Ester Sulphonates (MES), Surfactants and Phytonutrients. Our commitment to quality and sustainability positions us as a trusted partner across various industries, including home & personal care, pharmaceuticals, food & nutrition, flavours & fragrances, lubricants, polymers and industrial chemicals. With KLKOI, we aim to build stronger relationships with our customers, distributors, and partners across the Indian Subcontinent. Our local presence will allow us to expand our business portfolio, explore new opportunities, and tap into the growing Indian market. We are committed to going the extra mile and developing products that enrich all human lives, today and tomorrow. Learn how our sustainable solutions can benefit your business and the environment. | image | KLK OLEO ChemExpo India 2025 / KLK OLEO is one of the key players in the global oleochemical industry, manufacturing high-quality sustainable products from natural renewable raw materials for diverse end-use applications. With integrated oleochemicals complexes in key sourcing and supply markets (Malaysia, Indonesia, China, and Europe), the company’s extensive production portfolio includes basic oleochemicals— Fatty Acids, Glycerine, Fatty Alcohols, and Fatty Esters—to specialties such as Methyl Ester Sulphonates (MES), Surfactants and Phytonutrients. Discover how KLK OLEO can be your trusted partner for oleo-based products and solutions at ChemExpo India 2025 (Hall 3, Booth 3C07). | image | EN Sustainability Principled by Integrity Chart / Integrated, Reliable and Sustainable KLK and its subsidiaries including KLK OLEO are committed to protecting all its resources and incorporating environmentally friendly methods into its practices policies. At KLK OLEO, our principles on sustainability are guided by integrity. A strong sense of community is important to us. KLK policy reaches deep into the social welfare of its communities, through the provision of education and accessible health care. No deforestation and no new development in peat areas are the fundamental commitment from us that all oleochemicals produced are sustainable.  After years of experience in multisite RSPO Supply Chain Certification since 2012, KLK OLEO is now having 14 manufacturing facilities certified, strategically located in Malaysia, Indonesia, China and Europe. Our capability in delivering Traceable, Segregated and Mass Balance certified oleo-based products enable KLK OLEO continues to grow as the most trusted global partner in oleo-based products and solutions. Environmental management such as energy consumption, GHG emissions, water consumption, and solid waste generation are all closely monitored at sustainable levels. KLK OLEO Sustainable Practices are recognised by world standards, and is an exemplary model to sustain the ecological balance of the environment, during the production and manufacturing of oleochemicals produced. KLK OLEO. Trusted to enrich the global population with sustainability. | https://www.klkoleo.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/04/EN-Sustainability-Principled-by-Integrity-Chart-01.png |

| image | PALMESTER I PLANTERA MCT Oil and Powder   Sourced from renewable natural ingredients, PALMESTER I PLANTERA MCT delivers efficient energy in both oil and powder forms. Its 6–12 carbon chain structure allows for rapid absorption and quick energy release. The oil is neutral in taste, colourless, and odourless—ideal for functional food and beverage formulations. The powder offers versatility for meal replacements, active nutrition, and wellness products. Whether for performance or everyday vitality, PALMESTER I PLANTERA MCT drives innovation across today’s nutrition landscape.    Supporting Health Through Functional Nutrition   With a metabolic pathway distinct from long-chain fats in the human body, PALMESTER I PLANTERA MCT delivers quick energy, supports weight management, and fits well into ketogenic and digestive-friendly diets.    Versatile Applications Across Food Innovation   PALMESTER I PLANTERA MCT enhances nutritional value and product functionality across diverse applications, from indulgent spreads to next-generation meat alternatives, helping formulators achieve the ideal balance of health, taste, and performance. In Sauces and Dressings, it enables up to 40% fat substitution without the need for reformulation, delivering ideal texture, sensory appeal, and storage stability. In Plant-based Meat, it improves chewiness and elasticity, supports oxidative stability, offers potential for full fat replacement, and helps reduce calories by up to 18%. MCT is a flexible ingredient that fits easily into a wide range of food and beverage formats, supporting both everyday and emerging health-focused innovations. KLK OLEO offers PALMESTER I PLANTERA MCT oil in various grades, while MCT powders are available in different oil loadings to suit specific formulation needs.        Technical Assurance        *Above certification is applicable for specific product and/or plant. PLANT-BASED  • Vegetable feedstock  • 100% Bio-based  • Kosher  / Halal  LOCAL  • Made in Germany  • Non-EUDR feedstock  • European oil types  RENEWABLE  • Reducing reliance on fossil fuels  • Scalable in availability  • No by-product 																 								    								 							  							Poly Unsaturated Fatty AcidsPoly Unsaturated Fatty Acids  Manufacturing Site: Europe Product Code: SF10, SF15, RS65 Applications: Distilled fatty acids, such as rapeseed and sunflower oil.    TOFA Altenatives  Manufacturing Site: Europe Product Code: TL10, TL15, TL90, TL95 Properties/Features: Scalable in supply; No by-product; Low Colourant Applications: Vegetable alternative to tall oil fatty acids.    Soy-type Fatty Acid  Manufacturing Site: Europe Product Code: SY10 Properties/Features: Non-GMO Applications: Vegetable alternative to soy fatty acids.    Oleic Acid  Manufacturing Site: Europe Product Code: CR75 Applications: Used in the production of various esters, fatty alcohols, fatty acid isethionates, metallic soaps, fatty acid sarcosinates, imidazolines, fatty amines, oxazolines for paint binder, surfactants in personal care products, liquid and transparent soaps, corrosion/rust inhibitor for antifreeze; Used in agricultural chemicals, food, adhesive, crayon, candles, cements, coatings, inks, leather waxes, lubricants, metalworking, mining, pencils, capsules and ointments, plastics, rubber, textiles, etc.    Erucic Acid  Manufacturing Site: Europe Product Code:  Applications: Used in the production of fatty alcohol and their derivatives, esters, amides and surfactant; Used in coating and personal care; As plastic additives, lubricants, etc.    Behenic Acid  Manufacturing Site: Europe Product Code:  Applications: Used in the production of fatty alcohol and their derivatives; Used in paper chemicals, engineering plastics/moulding, personal care, I & I products, pharma intermediates, etc.  Dimer AcidDimer Acids in Standard and High Purity  Manufacturing Site: Europe Product Code: DM-27, DM-95, DM-98 Applications: Used in synthesis of non-nylon polyamides, hot melt adhesives, printing inks, paints and coatings; As epoxy curing agents, in corrosion inhibitors for oil field applications; Used in lubricants.  Trimer AcidTrimer Acid  Manufacturing Site: Europe Product Code: TR-50, TR-70 Properties/Features: Excellent hydrophobicity. Applications: Oilfield and coatings, e.g. flexible epoxy and polyamide resins.    Isostearic AcidIsostearic Acid  Manufacturing Site: Europe Product Code:  Applications: A main raw material for production of personal care and cosmetic ingredients such isopropyl isostearate, triisostearin, glyceryl isostearate, pentaerythritol tetraisostearate. | image | PALMESTER I PLANTERA MCT Oil and Powder   Sourced from renewable natural ingredients, PALMESTER I PLANTERA MCT delivers efficient energy in both oil and powder forms. Its 6–12 carbon chain structure allows for rapid absorption and quick energy release. The oil is neutral in taste, colourless, and odourless—ideal for functional food and beverage formulations. The powder offers versatility for meal replacements, active nutrition, and wellness products. Whether for performance or everyday vitality, PALMESTER I PLANTERA MCT drives innovation across today’s nutrition landscape.    Supporting Health Through Functional Nutrition   With a metabolic pathway distinct from long-chain fats in the human body, PALMESTER I PLANTERA MCT delivers quick energy, supports weight management, and fits well into ketogenic and digestive-friendly diets.    Versatile Applications Across Food Innovation   PALMESTER I PLANTERA MCT enhances nutritional value and product functionality across diverse applications, from indulgent spreads to next-generation meat alternatives, helping formulators achieve the ideal balance of health, taste, and performance. In Sauces and Dressings, it enables up to 40% fat substitution without the need for reformulation, delivering ideal texture, sensory appeal, and storage stability. In Plant-based Meat, it improves chewiness and elasticity, supports oxidative stability, offers potential for full fat replacement, and helps reduce calories by up to 18%. MCT is a flexible ingredient that fits easily into a wide range of food and beverage formats, supporting both everyday and emerging health-focused innovations. KLK OLEO offers PALMESTER I PLANTERA MCT oil in various grades, while MCT powders are available in different oil loadings to suit specific formulation needs.        Technical Assurance        *Above certification is applicable for specific product and/or plant.
